For runbooks 5 (migrations, recovery, backups), see [operations.md](operations.md). 6 7 > **No secrets or host details here.** Real hostnames, IPs, ports reserved on 8 > the host, credentials, and the reverse-proxy config live outside git (in 9 > `.kamal/secrets`, the operator's password manager, and the VPS itself). This 10 > page only names the variables. 11 12 ## Topology 13 14 ```mermaid 15 flowchart LR 16 subgraph public["Public internet"] 17 ssh["SSH (Kamal deploy user)"] 18 end 19 subgraph vpn["WireGuard VPN"] 20 user(["User browser"]) 21 end 22 subgraph host["VPS · Docker"] 23 nginx["nginx
(pre-existing, VPN interface)"] 24 proxy["kamal-proxy
bound to VPN IP only"] 25 app["app: zaimu-tomo
Phoenix release, port 4000"] 26 db[("accessory: db
postgres:18-alpine
host port on loopback only")] 27 rustfs[("accessory: rustfs
RustFS S3 API
not published to host")] 28 end 29 30 ssh --> host 31 user --> nginx --> proxy --> app 32 app -- "Docker DNS zaimu-tomo-db:5432" --> db 33 app -- "Docker DNS zaimu-tomo-rustfs:9000" --> rustfs 34 ``` 35 36 Key properties: 37 38 - **Kamal 2** (`config/deploy.yml`) builds an `amd64` image from `Dockerfile`, pushes it to GHCR, and runs it on one host over SSH. 39 - **Network exposure:** kamal-proxy binds only to the VPN interface (`KAMAL_PROXY_BIND_IP`) on a non-standard port, because nginx already owns port 80. nginx on the VPN interface forwards to kamal-proxy. Nothing is published on the public interface except SSH. TLS is off (`proxy.ssl: false`, no `FORCE_SSL`) because traffic stays inside WireGuard. 40 - **Accessories:** Postgres and RustFS run as Kamal accessories on the same host, reachable from the app through Docker DNS. Postgres's host port is bound to loopback only (for local admin). RustFS publishes no host port. 41 - **Watchtower** runs on the VPS for other containers. Every Kamal-managed container has the label `com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=false`, so only Kamal changes them. 42 - **Deploy user:** a dedicated SSH user (default `kamal`), key-only, in the `docker` group, with no sudo. Docker group membership is effectively root, so the protection comes from isolation and SSH hardening, not confinement. 43 - **Health:** kamal-proxy polls `GET /health` (and the image has a Docker `HEALTHCHECK`). `/up` is an alias. Both sit outside every router pipeline. 44 45 ## The image 46 47 `Dockerfile` is a two-stage build: `elixir:1.20.0-otp-28` builds the release 48 (`mix compile`, `mix assets.deploy`, `mix release`), and `debian:trixie-slim` 49 runs it as `nobody`. Release scripts from `rel/overlays/bin/` are included: 50 51 | Script | Purpose | 52 |---|---| 53 | `bin/migrate` | Run Ecto migrations. | 54 | `bin/recover_stuck_documents` | Re-enqueue stuck documents (dry run unless `CONFIRM=true`). | 55 | `bin/verify_storage` | HEAD every `documents.object_key` in the bucket. | 56 | `bin/backfill_document_fingerprints` | Fill missing document and journal-entry SHA-256 fingerprints (idempotent, online). Optional arguments: journal entry IDs a human confirmed as file reuses. | 57 | `bin/migrate_to_s3` | One-off legacy copy from the old upload volume. | 58 59 Keep the Elixir/OTP versions in sync across `Dockerfile`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, and `.agents/setup`. 60 61 ## Configuration and secrets 62 63 - Non-secret runtime config is in `config/deploy.yml` under `env.clear` (LLM backends and models, S3 endpoint and bucket, TypeSafe tuning, OTel service name). 64 - Secrets are listed in `env.secret` and `.kamal/secrets.example`. Copy the example to `.kamal/secrets` (git-ignored), or export the variables in your shell before running Kamal. `deploy.yml` uses ERB with `ENV.fetch`, so host values must be present in the environment: 65 66 ```sh 67 set -a; source .kamal/secrets; set +a 68 ``` 69 70 - Every variable is described in [configuration.md](configuration.md). 71 72 ## First-time setup (new host) 73 74 1. Prepare the host: install Docker, create the dedicated deploy user, set up the WireGuard interface, and configure nginx on the VPN interface to proxy to kamal-proxy's port (WebSocket upgrade headers are required for LiveView). 75 2. Locally: install Kamal, then fill `.kamal/secrets` (generate `SECRET_KEY_BASE` with `mix phx.gen.secret`). `DATABASE_URL` points at the accessory (`…@zaimu-tomo-db:5432/zaimu_tomo_prod`). 76 3. Boot the accessories and the app: 77 78 ```sh 79 kamal accessory boot db 80 kamal accessory boot rustfs 81 kamal setup 82 kamal migrate 83 ``` 84 85 4. In the RustFS console (reached through an SSH tunnel, never published), create the bucket named by `S3_BUCKET` **with versioning and Object Lock enabled**. Object Lock cannot be added after creation. 86 5. Check the app over the VPN, and run `kamal verify_storage`. 87 88 ## Routine deploy 89 90 ```sh 91 set -a; source .kamal/secrets; set +a 92 kamal deploy 93 kamal migrate # when the release contains migrations 94 ``` 95 96 Notes: 97 98 - Kamal performs a zero-downtime switch at the proxy. In-flight Oban jobs on the old container are rescued by `Oban.Lifeline` after 30 minutes, if they don't finish during shutdown. 99 - Migrations run *after* the new container is live, so write migrations that the previous release can run against (additive first, destructive later). 100 - Kamal aliases (`config/deploy.yml` → `aliases`) are invoked directly: `kamal console`, `kamal migrate`, `kamal db_rollback`, `kamal verify_storage`, `kamal recover_stuck_documents`, `kamal backfill_document_fingerprints`, `kamal migrate_to_s3`. 101 102 ## CI 103 104 GitHub Actions (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`) runs on pushes to `main` and on every 105 PR, for any base branch so stacked PRs are covered, as three jobs: `lint` (format 106 check, blocking `mix credo --strict`, unused-dependency check), `test` (compiles 107 with warnings as errors, migrates a Postgres 18 service, runs `mix test`), and `security-audit` 108 (`mix hex.audit`, advisory/non-blocking — a new CVE in an unrelated dependency 109 shouldn't block unrelated work). A separate scheduled workflow 110 (`.github/workflows/nightly-audit.yml`) re-runs `mix hex.audit` nightly, since 111 that's the only way to catch a CVE disclosed on a day with no pushes at all. CI 112 does **not** deploy. Deploys are manual with Kamal from the operator's machine. 113 Dependabot opens grouped dependency bumps. 114 115 A separate scheduled workflow (`.github/workflows/nightly-dialyzer.yml`) runs 116 `mix dialyzer` nightly, with its PLTs cached under `priv/plts` (keyed on 117 `mix.lock`, rebuilt only when dependencies change). Advisory, not a required 118 check: Dialyzer's whole-program success typing is a complementary, slower 119 check that doesn't gate pushes. Known tool/stdlib false positives are 120 suppressed in `.dialyzer_ignore.exs`, each with a comment explaining why it's 121 benign — re-verify them after any Ecto, Elixir, or OTP upgrade. 122 123 All jobs in all three workflows pin `runs-on: ubuntu-26.04` rather than 124 `ubuntu-latest`, so a GitHub image migration can't silently change the toolchain 125 under a green build. # MCP Server Instructions

The following MCP servers have provided instructions for how to use their tools and resources:

## claude.ai Claude Docs
Claude Docs: living docs you create and edit here. A docs skill your client lists → load it before any docs call — also before a `read`, comment or tab change on a claude.ai …/artifact/… link (the link is a doc; never web-fetch it). No docs skill or guide text loaded → `guide( items = ["topic.index"] )` alone before any docs call but a doc's birth. Make a doc here — not a local file, even when coding — only when the user asks for one, and make it FIRST: the turn's first tool call is its skeleton (title, byline, a `pending` block per section) — a reflex: send it before any search, file read, plan, `guide` or thinking it through; think once it is open — `batch( container = {"kind":"project","create":{"name":"<title>","doc":{"blocks":{"asof":{"type":"date","value":"<today>"},"me":{"type":"mention","user":"me"},"s1":{"type":"pending","intent":"Goals: the three outcomes this quarter commits to"},"s2":{…}},"markdown":"# <title>\n\n<?claude block asof?> · <?claude block me?>\n\n<?claude block s1?>\n\n<?claude block s2?>"}}}, batch = [] )` (`<?claude block k?>` ↔ `blocks.k`); its ack links the doc → `open` it with your Artifact tool (none → start your next message with the link, once); they're likely watching it fill — keep them posted in a short line naming what you're on (outline up; now <topic>); findings go in the doc, not chat; then `guide( items = ["topic.index"] )`, research, and fill each section: `replace` its pending id with `## <heading>` + body; end with one line + the link, never the document. Summoned by a doc comment (turn headed `[Artifact comment sent to Claude]`, `;thread=<root id>`): answer ONLY with a doc comment under that root (`create` an utterance, parent `<root id>`) — no artifact/platform comment tool: that relay thread is resolved and never reaches the doc; an edit asked there → `update` with `answering: "<root id>"`.

## funes
Persistent memory over the user's past AI coding sessions: their transcripts, indexed automatically as they work and read-only here — nothing has to be saved. When earlier work matters, this is the memory to consult.

1	defmodule ZaimuTomo.Review do
2	  @moduledoc """
3	  Context for reviewing OCR/LLM processed invoice data.
4	
5	  Handles approve / reject / amend decisions on extracted invoices.
6	  Each decision updates a single ReviewDecision row in place and appends
7	  an immutable entry to EventLog for audit purposes.
8	  """
9	
10	  import Ecto.Query, warn: false
11	  require Logger
12	
13	  alias Ecto.Multi
14	  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting
15	  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounts.Scope
16	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent
17	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedData
18	  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Document
19	  alias ZaimuTomo.Langfuse
20	  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo
21	  alias ZaimuTomo.Review.EventLog
22	  alias ZaimuTomo.Review.ReviewDecision
23	
24	  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
25	  # Initial decision creation (called by OCR worker)
26	  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
27	
28	  def create_initial_decision(%ExtractedContent{} = content) do
29	    ReviewDecision.changeset_for_create(%{
30	      extracted_content_id: content.id,
31	      user_id: content.user_id,
32	      review_status: "pending",
33	      decision_type: "initial",
34	      original_data: content.extracted_data
35	    })
36	    |> Repo.insert()
37	  end
38	
39	  def create_failed_decision(%ExtractedContent{} = content, error) do
40	    ReviewDecision.changeset_for_create(%{
41	      extracted_content_id: content.id,
42	      user_id: content.user_id,
43	      review_status: "failed",
44	      decision_type: "failed",
45	      review_notes: failure_review_note(error)
46	    })
47	    |> Repo.insert()
48	  end
49	
50	  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
51	  # Human review actions
52	  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
53	
54	  @doc """
55	  Approves a pending invoice and posts its journal entry in one transaction.
56	
57	  Options:
58	
59	    * `:confirm_file_reuse` — `true` when the reviewer explicitly confirmed
60	      that the source file is a legitimate reuse (for example, a reused
61	      QR-bill) of an already posted file. Honored only when the duplicate
62	      check's verdict is `:file_reuse`; see `post_review_transaction/6`.
63	    * `:booking` — `%{category, need_or_want, notes}`; when given, the journal
64	      entry is created already categorized and posted instead of
65	      `uncategorized`, in the same transaction.
66	    * `:tax_claim_attrs` — attributes for the entry's tax deduction claim,
67	      such as `%{"status" => "candidate"}`; defaults to undecided.
68	
69	  Returns `{:error, :duplicate_invoice}` when a duplicate blocks the posting
70	  and `{:error, :file_reuse_not_applicable}` when a reuse was confirmed but
71	  no confirmable file match exists.
72	  """
73	  def approve_invoice(extracted_content_id, user_id, notes \\ nil, opts \\ []) do
74	    with {:ok, decision} <- get_pending_decision(extracted_content_id, user_id) do
75	      post_review_transaction(
76	        decision,
77	        %{
78	          review_status: "approved",
79	          decision_type: "approved",
80	          review_notes: notes,
81	          review_completed_at: DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.truncate(:second)
82	        },
83	        "invoice_approved",
84	        %{notes: notes},
85	        "approved",
86	        opts
87	      )
88	    end
89	  end
90	
91	  def reject_invoice(extracted_content_id, user_id, rejection_reason, notes \\ nil) do
92	    with {:ok, decision} <- get_pending_decision(extracted_content_id, user_id),
93	         {:ok, updated} <-
94	           update_review_decision(decision, %{
95	             review_status: "rejected",
96	             decision_type: "rejected",
97	             rejection_reason: rejection_reason,
98	             review_notes: notes,
99	             review_completed_at: DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.truncate(:second)
100	           }) do
101	      write_event_log("invoice_rejected", extracted_content_id, user_id, %{
102	        rejection_reason: rejection_reason,
103	        notes: notes
104	      })
105	
106	      emit_review_completed_event(updated, "rejected")
107	      {:ok, updated}
108	    end
109	  end
110	
111	  @doc """
112	  Amends a pending invoice and posts its journal entry in one transaction.
113	
114	  Accepts the same options and errors as `approve_invoice/4`. The duplicate
115	  check runs on the amended facts, so correcting the date of a reused slip can
116	  turn a blocked exact-file match into a confirmable one.
117	  """
118	  def amend_invoice(extracted_content_id, user_id, amended_data, notes \\ nil, opts \\ []) do
119	    with {:ok, decision} <- get_pending_decision(extracted_content_id, user_id) do
120	      post_review_transaction(
121	        decision,
122	        %{
123	          review_status: "amended",
124	          decision_type: "amended",
125	          status: "completed",
126	          decision_data: amended_data,
127	          review_notes: notes,
128	          review_completed_at: NaiveDateTime.utc_now() |> NaiveDateTime.truncate(:second)
129	        },
130	        "invoice_amended",
131	        %{amended_data: amended_data, notes: notes},
132	        "amended",
133	        opts
134	      )
135	    end
136	  end
137	
138	  @doc """
139	  Scores the extraction of an invoice that was just posted, in the background.
140	
141	  Without an explicit `override` (`0` or `1`), the score is `1` when the
142	  invoice was posted as extracted and `0` when fields were corrected. The
143	  comment lists the corrected fields with their extracted and posted values;
144	  the reviewer's own comment is never sent. A no-op without a Langfuse trace.
145	  """
146	  @spec score_posted_extraction(ExtractedContent.t(), [{atom(), term(), term()}], 0 | 1 | nil) ::
147	          :ok
148	  def score_posted_extraction(content, changes, override \\ nil)
149	
150	  def score_posted_extraction(%ExtractedContent{trace_id: trace_id}, changes, override)
151	      when is_binary(trace_id) do
152	    value = override || if(changes == [], do: 1, else: 0)
153	
154	    comment =
155	      if changes != [] do
156	        "Corrected before posting: " <>
157	          Enum.map_join(changes, "; ", fn {field, from, to} ->
158	            "#{field} #{inspect(from)} -> #{inspect(to)}"
159	          end)
160	      end
161	
162	    send_extraction_score(trace_id, value, comment)
163	  end
164	
165	  def score_posted_extraction(_content, _changes, _override), do: :ok
166	
167	  @doc """
168	  Records the reviewer's explicit 👍/👎 (`1` or `0`) when rejecting an invoice,
169	  in the background. A rejection alone says nothing about the extraction (a
170	  correctly read duplicate is rejected too), so without a choice nothing is sent.
171	  The rejection reason is never sent.
172	  """
173	  @spec score_rejected_extraction(ExtractedContent.t(), 0 | 1 | nil) :: :ok
174	  def score_rejected_extraction(%ExtractedContent{trace_id: trace_id}, value)
175	      when is_binary(trace_id) and value in [0, 1] do
176	    send_extraction_score(trace_id, value, "Rejected before posting")
177	  end
178	
179	  def score_rejected_extraction(_content, _value), do: :ok
180	
181	  defp send_extraction_score(trace_id, value, comment) do
182	    Task.start(fn ->
183	      with {:error, reason} <- Langfuse.create_user_score(trace_id, value, comment) do
184	        Logger.warning("Failed to record extraction score: #{inspect(reason)}")
185	      end
186	    end)
187	
188	    :ok
189	  end
190	
191	  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
192	  # Queries
193	  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
194	
195	  @doc """
196	  Runs `Accounting.duplicate_check/3` for a review decision against `data`
197	  (its effective data, or amended data not yet saved), using the source
198	  document's fingerprint loaded through the decision's own user scope.
199	
200	  The fingerprint itself never leaves the server-side contexts.
201	  """
202	  @spec duplicate_check(ReviewDecision.t(), ExtractedData.t()) :: Accounting.duplicate_check()
203	  def duplicate_check(%ReviewDecision{} = decision, %ExtractedData{} = data) do
204	    Accounting.duplicate_check(decision.user_id, data, source_document_sha256(Repo, decision))
205	  end
206	
207	  def get_review_decision(id, user_id) do
208	    query =
209	      from rd in ReviewDecision,
210	        join: ec in ExtractedContent,
211	        on: ec.id == rd.extracted_content_id,
212	        where: rd.id == ^id,
213	        where: ec.user_id == ^user_id,
214	        preload: [extracted_content: ec]
215	
216	    case Repo.one(query) do
217	      nil -> {:error, "Review decision not found or not owned by user"}
218	      review_decision -> {:ok, review_decision}
219	    end
220	  end
221	
222	  @doc """
223	  Returns the number of the user's reviews awaiting a decision.
224	  """
225	  def pending_review_count(%Scope{} = scope) do
226	    from(rd in ReviewDecision,
227	      where: rd.user_id == ^scope.user.id,
228	      where: rd.review_status == "pending",
229	      select: count(rd.id)
230	    )
231	    |> Repo.one()
232	  end
233	
234	  def get_review_status_counts(user_id) do
235	    ReviewDecision
236	    |> join(:left, [rd], ec in ExtractedContent, on: ec.id == rd.extracted_content_id)
237	    |> where(
238	      [rd, ec],
239	      ec.user_id == ^user_id and
240	        rd.review_status in ["pending", "approved", "rejected", "amended"]
241	    )
242	    |> group_by([rd, _], rd.review_status)
243	    |> select([rd, _], %{status: rd.review_status, count: count(rd.id)})
244	    |> Repo.all()
245	    |> Enum.into(%{}, fn %{status: status, count: count} -> {String.to_atom(status), count} end)
246	  end
247	
248	  def update_review_decision(%ReviewDecision{} = review_decision, attrs) do
249	    review_decision
250	    |> ReviewDecision.changeset_for_update(attrs)
251	    |> Repo.update()
252	  end
253	
254	  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
255	  # Private helpers
256	  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
257	
258	  defp failure_review_note({type, _reason}) when is_atom(type),
259	    do: "Automatically marked as failed: #{type}"
260	
261	  defp failure_review_note(type) when is_atom(type),
262	    do: "Automatically marked as failed: #{type}"
263	
264	  defp failure_review_note(_error), do: "Automatically marked as failed: unknown error"
265	
266	  defp get_pending_decision(extracted_content_id, user_id) do
267	    query =
268	      from rd in ReviewDecision,
269	        join: ec in ExtractedContent,
270	        on: ec.id == rd.extracted_content_id,
271	        where: rd.extracted_content_id == ^extracted_content_id,
272	        where: ec.user_id == ^user_id,
273	        where: rd.review_status == "pending"
274	
275	    case Repo.one(query) do
276	      nil -> {:error, "No pending review found for this invoice"}
277	      decision -> {:ok, decision}
278	    end
279	  end
280	
281	  # Marks a pending review as approved or amended and posts its journal entry in
282	  # ONE transaction.
283	  #
284	  # The journal entry is created from the decision's effective data (amended data
285	  # when present, original otherwise) in the same transaction that updates the
286	  # review, and carries the source document's fingerprint. A duplicate invoice —
287	  # enforced by the unique (user, issuer, invoice number) index or the unique
288	  # (user, source file digest) index over unconfirmed postings — rolls the whole
289	  # transition back and the review stays pending. Returns
290	  # `{:error, :duplicate_invoice}` in that case, `{:error, changeset}` for other
291	  # failures.
292	  #
293	  # With `confirm_file_reuse: true`, the duplicate check is re-run inside the
294	  # transaction on the effective data. Only a `:file_reuse` verdict marks the
295	  # entry `source_file_reuse_confirmed` and records the confirmation with the
296	  # matched entry IDs in the event log; a blocked verdict is refused as a
297	  # duplicate, and any other verdict as `:file_reuse_not_applicable`, so a
298	  # confirmation is never inferred or applied to the wrong match.
299	  defp post_review_transaction(
300	         decision,
301	         changeset_attrs,
302	         event_type,
303	         event_metadata,
304	         status,
305	         opts
306	       ) do
307	    confirm_file_reuse? = Keyword.get(opts, :confirm_file_reuse, false) == true
308	
309	    booking = Keyword.get(opts, :booking)
310	    tax_claim_attrs = Keyword.get(opts, :tax_claim_attrs, %{})
311	
312	    event_metadata =
313	      if booking,
314	        do: Map.merge(event_metadata, %{booking: booking, tax_claim: tax_claim_attrs}),
315	        else: event_metadata
316	
317	    Multi.new()
318	    |> Multi.run(:source_document_sha256, fn repo, _changes ->
319	      {:ok, source_document_sha256(repo, decision)}
320	    end)
321	    |> Multi.update(
322	      :review_decision,
323	      ReviewDecision.changeset_for_update(decision, changeset_attrs)
324	    )
325	    |> Multi.run(:file_reuse, fn _repo, changes ->
326	      file_reuse_confirmation(confirm_file_reuse?, changes)
327	    end)
328	    |> Multi.merge(fn %{review_decision: updated} = changes ->
329	      Accounting.create_multi_from_decision(updated, tax_claim_attrs,
330	        source_document_sha256: changes.source_document_sha256,
331	        source_file_reuse_confirmed: changes.file_reuse != nil,
332	        booking: booking
333	      )
334	    end)
335	    |> Multi.run(:event_log, fn repo, %{review_decision: updated} ->
336	      insert_event_log(
337	        repo,
338	        event_type,
339	        updated.extracted_content_id,
340	        updated.user_id,
341	        event_metadata
342	      )
343	    end)

defmodule ZaimuTomo.Review do
  @moduledoc """
  Context for reviewing OCR/LLM processed invoice data.

  Handles approve / reject / amend decisions on extracted invoices.
  Each decision updates a single ReviewDecision row in place and appends
  an immutable entry to EventLog for audit purposes.
  """

  import Ecto.Query, warn: false
  require Logger

  alias Ecto.Multi
  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting
  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounts.Scope
  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent
  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedData
  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Document
  alias ZaimuTomo.Langfuse
  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo
  alias ZaimuTomo.Review.EventLog
  alias ZaimuTomo.Review.ReviewDecision

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Initial decision creation (called by OCR worker)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  def create_initial_decision(%ExtractedContent{} = content) do
    ReviewDecision.changeset_for_create(%{
      extracted_content_id: content.id,
      user_id: content.user_id,
      review_status: "pending",
      decision_type: "initial",
      original_data: content.extracted_data
    })
    |> Repo.insert()
  end

  def create_failed_decision(%ExtractedContent{} = content, error) do
    ReviewDecision.changeset_for_create(%{
      extracted_content_id: content.id,
      user_id: content.user_id,
      review_status: "failed",
      decision_type: "failed",
      review_notes: failure_review_note(error)
    })
    |> Repo.insert()
  end

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Human review actions
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  @doc """
  Approves a pending invoice and posts its journal entry in one transaction.

  Options:

    * `:confirm_file_reuse` — `true` when the reviewer explicitly confirmed
      that the source file is a legitimate reuse (for example, a reused
      QR-bill) of an already posted file. Honored only when the duplicate
      check's verdict is `:file_reuse`; see `post_review_transaction/6`.
    * `:booking` — `%{category, need_or_want, notes}`; when given, the journal
      entry is created already categorized and posted instead of
      `uncategorized`, in the same transaction.
    * `:tax_claim_attrs` — attributes for the entry's tax deduction claim,
      such as `%{"status" => "candidate"}`; defaults to undecided.

  Returns `{:error, :duplicate_invoice}` when a duplicate blocks the posting
  and `{:error, :file_reuse_not_applicable}` when a reuse was confirmed but
  no confirmable file match exists.
  """
  def approve_invoice(extracted_content_id, user_id, notes \\ nil, opts \\ []) do
    with {:ok, decision} <- get_pending_decision(extracted_content_id, user_id) do
      post_review_transaction(
        decision,
        %{
          review_status: "approved",
          decision_type: "approved",
          review_notes: notes,
          review_completed_at: DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.truncate(:second)
        },
        "invoice_approved",
        %{notes: notes},
        "approved",
        opts
      )
    end
  end

  def reject_invoice(extracted_content_id, user_id, rejection_reason, notes \\ nil) do
    with {:ok, decision} <- get_pending_decision(extracted_content_id, user_id),
         {:ok, updated} <-
           update_review_decision(decision, %{
             review_status: "rejected",
             decision_type: "rejected",
             rejection_reason: rejection_reason,
             review_notes: notes,
             review_completed_at: DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.truncate(:second)
           }) do
      write_event_log("invoice_rejected", extracted_content_id, user_id, %{
        rejection_reason: rejection_reason,
        notes: notes
      })

      emit_review_completed_event(updated, "rejected")
      {:ok, updated}
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Amends a pending invoice and posts its journal entry in one transaction.

  Accepts the same options and errors as `approve_invoice/4`. The duplicate
  check runs on the amended facts, so correcting the date of a reused slip can
  turn a blocked exact-file match into a confirmable one.
  """
  def amend_invoice(extracted_content_id, user_id, amended_data, notes \\ nil, opts \\ []) do
    with {:ok, decision} <- get_pending_decision(extracted_content_id, user_id) do
      post_review_transaction(
        decision,
        %{
          review_status: "amended",
          decision_type: "amended",
          status: "completed",
          decision_data: amended_data,
          review_notes: notes,
          review_completed_at: NaiveDateTime.utc_now() |> NaiveDateTime.truncate(:second)
        },
        "invoice_amended",
        %{amended_data: amended_data, notes: notes},
        "amended",
        opts
      )
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Scores the extraction of an invoice that was just posted, in the background.

  Without an explicit `override` (`0` or `1`), the score is `1` when the
  invoice was posted as extracted and `0` when fields were corrected. The
  comment lists the corrected fields with their extracted and posted values;
  the reviewer's own comment is never sent. A no-op without a Langfuse trace.
  """
  @spec score_posted_extraction(ExtractedContent.t(), [{atom(), term(), term()}], 0 | 1 | nil) ::
          :ok
  def score_posted_extraction(content, changes, override \\ nil)

  def score_posted_extraction(%ExtractedContent{trace_id: trace_id}, changes, override)
      when is_binary(trace_id) do
    value = override || if(changes == [], do: 1, else: 0)

    comment =
      if changes != [] do
        "Corrected before posting: " <>
          Enum.map_join(changes, "; ", fn {field, from, to} ->
            "#{field} #{inspect(from)} -> #{inspect(to)}"
          end)
      end

    send_extraction_score(trace_id, value, comment)
  end

  def score_posted_extraction(_content, _changes, _override), do: :ok

  @doc """
  Records the reviewer's explicit 👍/👎 (`1` or `0`) when rejecting an invoice,
  in the background. A rejection alone says nothing about the extraction (a
  correctly read duplicate is rejected too), so without a choice nothing is sent.
  The rejection reason is never sent.
  """
  @spec score_rejected_extraction(ExtractedContent.t(), 0 | 1 | nil) :: :ok
  def score_rejected_extraction(%ExtractedContent{trace_id: trace_id}, value)
      when is_binary(trace_id) and value in [0, 1] do
    send_extraction_score(trace_id, value, "Rejected before posting")
  end

  def score_rejected_extraction(_content, _value), do: :ok

  defp send_extraction_score(trace_id, value, comment) do
    Task.start(fn ->
      with {:error, reason} <- Langfuse.create_user_score(trace_id, value, comment) do
        Logger.warning("Failed to record extraction score: #{inspect(reason)}")
      end
    end)

    :ok
  end

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Queries
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  @doc """
  Runs `Accounting.duplicate_check/3` for a review decision against `data`
  (its effective data, or amended data not yet saved), using the source
  document's fingerprint loaded through the decision's own user scope.

  The fingerprint itself never leaves the server-side contexts.
  """
  @spec duplicate_check(ReviewDecision.t(), ExtractedData.t()) :: Accounting.duplicate_check()
  def duplicate_check(%ReviewDecision{} = decision, %ExtractedData{} = data) do
    Accounting.duplicate_check(decision.user_id, data, source_document_sha256(Repo, decision))
  end

  def get_review_decision(id, user_id) do
    query =
      from rd in ReviewDecision,
        join: ec in ExtractedContent,
        on: ec.id == rd.extracted_content_id,
        where: rd.id == ^id,
        where: ec.user_id == ^user_id,
        preload: [extracted_content: ec]

    case Repo.one(query) do
      nil -> {:error, "Review decision not found or not owned by user"}
      review_decision -> {:ok, review_decision}
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Returns the number of the user's reviews awaiting a decision.
  """
  def pending_review_count(%Scope{} = scope) do
    from(rd in ReviewDecision,
      where: rd.user_id == ^scope.user.id,
      where: rd.review_status == "pending",
      select: count(rd.id)
    )
    |> Repo.one()
  end

  def get_review_status_counts(user_id) do
    ReviewDecision
    |> join(:left, [rd], ec in ExtractedContent, on: ec.id == rd.extracted_content_id)
    |> where(
      [rd, ec],
      ec.user_id == ^user_id and
        rd.review_status in ["pending", "approved", "rejected", "amended"]
    )
    |> group_by([rd, _], rd.review_status)
    |> select([rd, _], %{status: rd.review_status, count: count(rd.id)})
    |> Repo.all()
    |> Enum.into(%{}, fn %{status: status, count: count} -> {String.to_atom(status), count} end)
  end

  def update_review_decision(%ReviewDecision{} = review_decision, attrs) do
    review_decision
    |> ReviewDecision.changeset_for_update(attrs)
    |> Repo.update()
  end

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private helpers
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  defp failure_review_note({type, _reason}) when is_atom(type),
    do: "Automatically marked as failed: #{type}"

  defp failure_review_note(type) when is_atom(type),
    do: "Automatically marked as failed: #{type}"

  defp failure_review_note(_error), do: "Automatically marked as failed: unknown error"

  defp get_pending_decision(extracted_content_id, user_id) do
    query =
      from rd in ReviewDecision,
        join: ec in ExtractedContent,
        on: ec.id == rd.extracted_content_id,
        where: rd.extracted_content_id == ^extracted_content_id,
        where: ec.user_id == ^user_id,
        where: rd.review_status == "pending"

    case Repo.one(query) do
      nil -> {:error, "No pending review found for this invoice"}
      decision -> {:ok, decision}
    end
  end

  # Marks a pending review as approved or amended and posts its journal entry in
  # ONE transaction.
  #
  # The journal entry is created from the decision's effective data (amended data
  # when present, original otherwise) in the same transaction that updates the
  # review, and carries the source document's fingerprint. A duplicate invoice —
  # enforced by the unique (user, issuer, invoice number) index or the unique
  # (user, source file digest) index over unconfirmed postings — rolls the whole
  # transition back and the review stays pending. Returns
  # `{:error, :duplicate_invoice}` in that case, `{:error, changeset}` for other
  # failures.
  #
  # With `confirm_file_reuse: true`, the duplicate check is re-run inside the
  # transaction on the effective data. Only a `:file_reuse` verdict marks the
  # entry `source_file_reuse_confirmed` and records the confirmation with the
  # matched entry IDs in the event log; a blocked verdict is refused as a
  # duplicate, and any other verdict as `:file_reuse_not_applicable`, so a
  # confirmation is never inferred or applied to the wrong match.
  defp post_review_transaction(
         decision,
         changeset_attrs,
         event_type,
         event_metadata,
         status,
         opts
       ) do
    confirm_file_reuse? = Keyword.get(opts, :confirm_file_reuse, false) == true

    booking = Keyword.get(opts, :booking)
    tax_claim_attrs = Keyword.get(opts, :tax_claim_attrs, %{})

    event_metadata =
      if booking,
        do: Map.merge(event_metadata, %{booking: booking, tax_claim: tax_claim_attrs}),
        else: event_metadata

    Multi.new()
    |> Multi.run(:source_document_sha256, fn repo, _changes ->
      {:ok, source_document_sha256(repo, decision)}
    end)
    |> Multi.update(
      :review_decision,
      ReviewDecision.changeset_for_update(decision, changeset_attrs)
    )
    |> Multi.run(:file_reuse, fn _repo, changes ->
      file_reuse_confirmation(confirm_file_reuse?, changes)
    end)
    |> Multi.merge(fn %{review_decision: updated} = changes ->
      Accounting.create_multi_from_decision(updated, tax_claim_attrs,
        source_document_sha256: changes.source_document_sha256,
        source_file_reuse_confirmed: changes.file_reuse != nil,
        booking: booking
      )
    end)
    |> Multi.run(:event_log, fn repo, %{review_decision: updated} ->
      insert_event_log(
        repo,
        event_type,
        updated.extracted_content_id,
        updated.user_id,
        event_metadata
      )
    end)
    |> Multi.run(:file_reuse_event_log, fn repo, changes ->
      insert_file_reuse_event_log(repo, changes)
    end)
    |> Repo.transaction()
    |> case do
      {:ok, %{review_decision: updated}} ->
        emit_review_completed_event(updated, status)
        {:ok, updated}

      {:error, :file_reuse, reason, _changes} ->
        {:error, reason}

      {:error, :journal_entry, %Ecto.Changeset{} = changeset, _changes} ->
        if Accounting.duplicate_error?(changeset) do
          {:error, :duplicate_invoice}
        else
          {:error, changeset}
        end

      {:error, _operation, %Ecto.Changeset{} = changeset, _changes} ->
        {:error, changeset}
    end
  end

  defp file_reuse_confirmation(false, _changes), do: {:ok, nil}

  defp file_reuse_confirmation(true, %{
         review_decision: updated,
         source_document_sha256: source_sha256
       }) do
    check =
      Accounting.duplicate_check(
        updated.user_id,
        ReviewDecision.effective_data(updated),
        source_sha256
      )

    case check.verdict do
      :file_reuse ->
        {:ok, %{matched_journal_entry_ids: Enum.map(check.candidates, & &1.entry.id)}}

      verdict when verdict in [:invoice_number, :same_file_blocked] ->
        {:error, :duplicate_invoice}

      _no_file_match ->
        {:error, :file_reuse_not_applicable}
    end
  end

  defp insert_file_reuse_event_log(_repo, %{file_reuse: nil}), do: {:ok, nil}

  defp insert_file_reuse_event_log(repo, %{
         file_reuse: %{matched_journal_entry_ids: [matched_id | _] = matched_ids},
         journal_entry: entry,
         review_decision: updated
       }) do
    insert_event_log(
      repo,
      "source_file_reuse_confirmed",
      updated.extracted_content_id,
      updated.user_id,
      %{
        journal_entry_id: entry.id,
        matched_journal_entry_id: matched_id,
        matched_journal_entry_ids: matched_ids
      }
    )
  end

  # Loads the decision's source document fingerprint, scoped to the decision's
  # user through both the extraction and the document.
  defp source_document_sha256(repo, %ReviewDecision{} = decision) do
    from(ec in ExtractedContent,
      join: d in Document,
      on: d.id == ec.document_id,
      where: ec.id == ^decision.extracted_content_id,
      where: ec.user_id == ^decision.user_id and d.user_id == ^decision.user_id,
      select: d.content_sha256
    )
    |> repo.one()
  end

  # Best-effort audit write for transitions that do not post a journal entry.
  defp write_event_log(event_type, invoice_id, user_id, metadata) do
    case insert_event_log(Repo, event_type, invoice_id, user_id, metadata) do
      {:ok, _event_log} ->
        :ok

      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.warning("Failed to write event log for #{event_type}: #{inspect(reason)}")
        :ok
    end
  end

  # Inside the posting transaction the audit entry is required: an error
  # rolls back the review update and the journal entry with it.
  defp insert_event_log(repo, event_type, invoice_id, user_id, metadata) do
    %{
      event_type: event_type,
      invoice_id: to_string(invoice_id),
      user_id: user_id,
      metadata: metadata,
      status: "completed"
    }
    |> EventLog.changeset_for_create()
    |> repo.insert()
  end

  defp emit_review_completed_event(%ReviewDecision{} = decision, status) do
    Phoenix.PubSub.broadcast(ZaimuTomo.PubSub, "invoice_review:completed", %{
      invoice_id: decision.extracted_content_id,
      status: status,
      user_id: decision.user_id,
      decision_data: decision.decision_data,
      timestamp: DateTime.utc_now()
    })
  end
end

1	defmodule ZaimuTomo.Accounting do
2	  @moduledoc """
3	  Context for budget journal entries.
4	
5	  Journal entries are created automatically from approved/amended invoices.
6	  A human assigns a budget category and need/want classification to post each entry.
7	  """
8	
9	  import Ecto.Query, warn: false
10	
11	  alias Ecto.Multi
12	  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.JournalEntry
13	  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.TaxDeductionClaim
14	  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounts.Scope
15	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedData
16	  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo
17	  alias ZaimuTomo.Review.EventLog
18	  alias ZaimuTomo.Review.ReviewDecision
19	
20	  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
21	  # Duplicate detection
22	  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
23	
24	  @doc """
25	  Returns journal entries already recorded for this user that appear to be the
26	  same invoice as `data` (an `%ExtractedData{}` with the invoice's final,
27	  reviewer-confirmed values).
28	
29	  * With an invoice number, the strong match is (user, issuer, invoice number),
30	    compared case-insensitively with surrounding whitespace trimmed.
31	  * Without a number, a soft match requires the exact tuple (issuer, date,
32	    amount, currency). A missing component never matches.
33	
34	  Candidates from other users are never returned.
35	  """
36	  @spec duplicate_candidates(integer() | nil, ExtractedData.t()) :: [JournalEntry.t()]
37	  def duplicate_candidates(nil, %ExtractedData{}), do: []
38	
39	  def duplicate_candidates(user_id, %ExtractedData{} = data) do
40	    base =
41	      from(je in JournalEntry,
42	        where: je.user_id == ^user_id,
43	        where: fragment("lower(btrim(?)) = lower(btrim(?))", je.issuer, ^data.issuer),
44	        order_by: [desc: je.inserted_at],
45	        limit: 5
46	      )
47	
48	    base
49	    |> candidate_filters(data)
50	    |> Repo.all()
51	  end
52	
53	  @typedoc """
54	  Why a journal entry is a duplicate candidate, strongest first: the same
55	  uploaded file, the same (issuer, invoice number), or the same
56	  (issuer, date, amount, currency) tuple.
57	  """
58	  @type match_reason :: :same_file | :invoice_number | :same_details
59	
60	  @typedoc """
61	  The outcome of `duplicate_check/3`.
62	
63	  * `:none` — no candidate; post freely.
64	  * `:possible` — only a soft (issuer, date, amount, currency) match; posting
65	    needs the existing explicit "post anyway" confirmation.
66	  * `:file_reuse` — the same uploaded file and nothing else matches; posting
67	    needs an explicit file-reuse confirmation (for example, a reused QR-bill).
68	  * `:invoice_number` — the invoice number is already recorded for the issuer;
69	    blocked until the data is amended.
70	  * `:same_file_blocked` — the same uploaded file and the invoice facts also
71	    match; blocked, the review should be rejected.
72	  """
73	  @type verdict :: :none | :possible | :file_reuse | :invoice_number | :same_file_blocked
74	
75	  @type duplicate_check :: %{
76	          verdict: verdict(),
77	          candidates: [%{entry: JournalEntry.t(), reason: match_reason()}]
78	        }
79	
80	  @doc """
81	  Checks `data` (the invoice's final values) and the source document's
82	  fingerprint against the user's journal entries.
83	
84	  Combines `duplicate_candidates/2` with an exact match on
85	  `source_document_sha256`. A candidate matching several rules is listed once
86	  with its strongest reason. An exact-file match is confirmable as a reuse only
87	  when neither field rule matches; the (issuer, date, amount, currency) tuple
88	  is also compared against the file-matched entries even when `data` has an
89	  invoice number, so the same file with the same facts is never confirmable.
90	
91	  A nil fingerprint never matches, and other users' entries are never queried.
92	  """
93	  @spec duplicate_check(integer() | nil, ExtractedData.t(), String.t() | nil) ::
94	          duplicate_check()
95	  def duplicate_check(nil, %ExtractedData{}, _source_sha256),
96	    do: %{verdict: :none, candidates: []}
97	
98	  def duplicate_check(user_id, %ExtractedData{} = data, source_sha256) do
99	    field_matches = duplicate_candidates(user_id, data)
100	    file_matches = file_candidates(user_id, source_sha256)
101	    field_reason = if strong_match?(data, field_matches), do: :invoice_number, else: :same_details
102	
103	    verdict =
104	      cond do
105	        file_matches != [] and
106	            (field_matches != [] or same_details_as_file_match?(user_id, data, file_matches)) ->
107	          :same_file_blocked
108	
109	        file_matches != [] ->
110	          :file_reuse
111	
112	        field_reason == :invoice_number ->
113	          :invoice_number
114	
115	        field_matches != [] ->
116	          :possible
117	
118	        true ->
119	          :none
120	      end
121	
122	    candidates =
123	      Enum.map(file_matches, &%{entry: &1, reason: :same_file}) ++
124	        Enum.map(field_matches, &%{entry: &1, reason: field_reason})
125	
126	    %{verdict: verdict, candidates: Enum.uniq_by(candidates, & &1.entry.id)}
127	  end
128	
129	  @doc "True when a `duplicate_check/3` verdict forbids posting outright."
130	  @spec blocked?(duplicate_check()) :: boolean()
131	  def blocked?(%{verdict: verdict}), do: verdict in [:invoice_number, :same_file_blocked]
132	
133	  defp file_candidates(_user_id, nil), do: []
134	
135	  defp file_candidates(user_id, source_sha256) when is_binary(source_sha256) do
136	    from(je in JournalEntry,
137	      where: je.user_id == ^user_id and je.source_document_sha256 == ^source_sha256,
138	      order_by: [desc: je.inserted_at, desc: je.id]
139	    )
140	    |> Repo.all()
141	  end
142	
143	  defp same_details_as_file_match?(user_id, data, file_matches) do
144	    ids = Enum.map(file_matches, & &1.id)
145	
146	    from(je in JournalEntry,
147	      where: je.user_id == ^user_id and je.id in ^ids,
148	      where: fragment("lower(btrim(?)) = lower(btrim(?))", je.issuer, ^data.issuer),
149	      select: count(je.id)
150	    )
151	    |> soft_match_filters(data)
152	    |> Repo.one()
153	    |> Kernel.>(0)
154	  end
155	
156	  # Numbered and unnumbered matches are mutually exclusive: a nonblank invoice
157	  # number is the identity, otherwise the exact tuple is compared.
158	  defp candidate_filters(query, %ExtractedData{invoice_number: number} = data) do
159	    if invoice_number?(number) do
160	      where(
161	        query,
162	        [je],
163	        fragment("lower(btrim(?)) = lower(btrim(?))", je.invoice_number, ^number)
164	      )
165	    else
166	      soft_match_filters(query, data)
167	    end
168	  end
169	
170	  # The unnumbered tuple needs every component; a missing or malformed one
171	  # (for example, a nil amount or a non-ISO date) never matches.
172	  defp soft_match_filters(query, %ExtractedData{
173	         amount_to_pay_cents: amount,
174	         invoice_date: invoice_date,
175	         currency: currency
176	       })
177	       when is_integer(amount) and is_binary(invoice_date) and is_binary(currency) do
178	    with false <- String.trim(currency) == "",
179	         {:ok, date} <- Date.from_iso8601(invoice_date) do
180	      where(
181	        query,
182	        [je],
183	        je.date == ^date and
184	          je.amount_cents == ^amount and
185	          fragment("lower(btrim(?)) = lower(btrim(?))", je.currency, ^currency)
186	      )
187	    else
188	      _ -> where(query, false)
189	    end
190	  end
191	
192	  defp soft_match_filters(query, %ExtractedData{}), do: where(query, false)
193	
194	  defp invoice_number?(number), do: is_binary(number) and String.trim(number) != ""
195	
196	  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
197	  # Entry creation (called after invoice approval / amendment)
198	  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
199	
200	  @spec create_from_decision(ReviewDecision.t(), map()) ::
201	          {:ok, JournalEntry.t()} | {:error, Ecto.Changeset.t()}
202	  def create_from_decision(%ReviewDecision{} = decision, tax_claim_attrs \\ %{}) do
203	    create_multi_from_decision(decision, tax_claim_attrs)
204	    |> Repo.transaction()
205	    |> case do
206	      {:ok, %{journal_entry: entry, tax_deduction_claim: claim}} ->
207	        {:ok, %{entry | tax_deduction_claim: claim}}
208	
209	      {:error, _operation, changeset, _changes} ->
210	        {:error, changeset}
211	    end
212	  end
213	
214	  @doc """
215	  Builds an `Ecto.Multi` that creates the journal entry and its tax deduction
216	  claim for an approved/amended review decision.
217	
218	  The step names (`:journal_entry`, `:tax_deduction_claim`) are stable so
219	  callers can compose this multi into a larger transaction, such as the
220	  review-to-journal-entry transition that must roll back on a duplicate
221	  invoice.
222	
223	  Options:
224	
225	    * `:source_document_sha256` — the source document's fingerprint, copied
226	      to the entry as an immutable posting-time snapshot.
227	    * `:source_file_reuse_confirmed` — `true` only when the reviewer explicitly
228	      confirmed a reuse of the same file; defaults to `false`.
229	    * `:booking` — a map with `category`, `need_or_want` and `notes`. When
230	      given, the entry is categorized and posted in the same multi (step
231	      `:posted_journal_entry`), so an invoice can be checked and booked in one
232	      step. Without it the entry stays `uncategorized`.
233	  """
234	  @spec create_multi_from_decision(ReviewDecision.t(), map(), keyword()) :: Ecto.Multi.t()
235	  def create_multi_from_decision(
236	        %ReviewDecision{} = decision,
237	        tax_claim_attrs \\ %{},
238	        opts \\ []
239	      ) do
240	    data = decision.decision_data || decision.original_data
241	
242	    attrs = %{
243	      review_decision_id: decision.id,
244	      user_id: decision.user_id,
245	      amount_cents: data.amount_to_pay_cents,
246	      currency: data.currency,
247	      date: parse_date(data.invoice_date),
248	      description: data.reason_for_payment,
249	      issuer: data.issuer,
250	      invoice_number: data.invoice_number,
251	      status: "uncategorized",
252	      source_document_sha256: Keyword.get(opts, :source_document_sha256),
253	      source_file_reuse_confirmed: Keyword.get(opts, :source_file_reuse_confirmed, false)
254	    }
255	
256	    tax_claim_attrs = normalize_tax_claim_attrs(attrs.amount_cents, tax_claim_attrs)
257	
258	    Multi.new()
259	    |> Multi.insert(:journal_entry, JournalEntry.changeset_for_create(attrs))
260	    |> Multi.run(:tax_deduction_claim, fn repo, %{journal_entry: entry} ->
261	      TaxDeductionClaim.changeset_for_create(entry, tax_claim_attrs) |> repo.insert()
262	    end)
263	    |> maybe_post_booking(Keyword.get(opts, :booking))
264	  end
265	
266	  defp maybe_post_booking(multi, nil), do: multi
267	
268	  defp maybe_post_booking(multi, booking) when is_map(booking) do
269	    Multi.update(multi, :posted_journal_entry, fn %{journal_entry: entry} ->
270	      booking = Map.new(booking, fn {key, value} -> {to_string(key), value} end)
271	
272	      JournalEntry.changeset_for_categorize(entry, Map.put(booking, "status", "posted"))
273	    end)
274	    |> Multi.insert(:posted_event, fn %{posted_journal_entry: entry, tax_deduction_claim: claim} ->
275	      posted_event_changeset(entry, claim.status)
276	    end)
277	  end
278	
279	  @doc """
280	  True when a journal-entry insert failed on the unique
281	  (user, issuer, invoice number) index or the unique (user, source file
282	  digest) index over unconfirmed postings.
283	
284	  Matches the constraint name rather than the error message, so unrelated
285	  changeset errors are never mistaken for a duplicate.
286	  """
287	  @spec duplicate_error?(Ecto.Changeset.t()) :: boolean()
288	  def duplicate_error?(%Ecto.Changeset{errors: errors}) do
289	    duplicate_indexes = [
290	      JournalEntry.duplicate_invoice_index(),
291	      JournalEntry.duplicate_source_file_index()
292	    ]
293	
294	    Enum.any?(errors, fn {_field, {_message, opts}} ->
295	      opts[:constraint] == :unique and opts[:constraint_name] in duplicate_indexes
296	    end)
297	  end
298	
299	  def duplicate_error?(_other), do: false
300	
301	  @doc """
302	  Fetches the journal entry created for a review decision, if any.
303	  """
304	  @spec get_journal_entry_for_decision(integer() | String.t()) ::
305	          {:ok, JournalEntry.t()} | :error
306	  def get_journal_entry_for_decision(review_decision_id) do
307	    case Repo.get_by(JournalEntry, review_decision_id: review_decision_id) do
308	      nil ->
309	        :error
310	
311	      entry ->
312	        {:ok, Repo.preload(entry, :tax_deduction_claim)}
313	    end
314	  end
315	
316	  @doc """
317	  True when `candidates` (from `duplicate_candidates/2` for the same `data`)
318	  matched on the invoice number — the strong, blocking kind of duplicate.
319	
320	  Strength follows the rule that matched, which is decided by whether `data`
321	  has an invoice number; a numbered entry found through the unnumbered tuple
322	  is only a possible duplicate.
323	  """
324	  @spec strong_match?(ExtractedData.t(), [JournalEntry.t()]) :: boolean()
325	  def strong_match?(%ExtractedData{}, []), do: false
326	
327	  def strong_match?(%ExtractedData{invoice_number: number}, [_ | _]),
328	    do: invoice_number?(number)
329	
330	  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
331	  # Posting (category assignment)
332	  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
333	
334	  @spec post_entry(JournalEntry.t(), integer(), String.t(), String.t(), String.t() | nil, map()) ::
335	          {:ok, JournalEntry.t()} | {:error, Ecto.Changeset.t()}
336	  def post_entry(
337	        %JournalEntry{} = entry,
338	        user_id,
339	        category,
340	        need_or_want,
341	        notes \\ nil,
342	        tax_claim_attrs \\ %{}
343	      ) do
344	    true = entry.user_id == user_id
345	
346	    Multi.new()
347	    |> Multi.update(
348	      :journal_entry,
349	      JournalEntry.changeset_for_categorize(entry, %{
350	        category: category,
351	        need_or_want: need_or_want,
352	        notes: notes,
353	        status: "posted"
354	      })
355	    )
356	    |> Multi.run(:tax_deduction_claim, fn repo, %{journal_entry: updated} ->
357	      upsert_tax_deduction_claim(repo, updated, tax_claim_attrs)
358	    end)
359	    |> Multi.insert(:posted_event, fn %{journal_entry: updated, tax_deduction_claim: claim} ->
360	      posted_event_changeset(updated, claim.status)
361	    end)
362	    |> Repo.transaction()
363	    |> case do
364	      {:ok, %{journal_entry: updated, tax_deduction_claim: claim}} ->
365	        {:ok, %{updated | tax_deduction_claim: claim}}
366	
367	      {:error, _operation, changeset, _changes} ->
368	        {:error, changeset}
369	    end
370	  end
371	
372	  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
373	  # Queries
374	  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
375	
376	  @doc """
377	  Returns posted spending totals for the current UTC month.
378	
379	  Until currency conversion is introduced, amounts in every source currency
380	  are treated as equivalent and displayed using the user's base currency.
381	  """
382	  def current_month_spending(%Scope{} = scope) do
383	    current_month_spending(scope, Date.utc_today())
384	  end
385	
386	  @doc """
387	  Returns posted spending totals for the month containing `reference_date`.
388	
389	  The explicit date keeps month-boundary behavior deterministic for callers
390	  such as tests and historical reports.
391	  """
392	  def current_month_spending(%Scope{} = scope, %Date{} = reference_date) do
393	    monthly_spending(scope, reference_date)
394	  end
395	
396	  @doc """
397	  Returns posted spending totals for the month containing `reference_date`.
398	  """
399	  def monthly_spending(%Scope{user: user}, %Date{} = reference_date) do
400	    user_id = user.id
401	    month_start = Date.beginning_of_month(reference_date)
402	    next_month_start = month_start |> Date.add(32) |> Date.beginning_of_month()
403	
404	    categories =
405	      from(je in JournalEntry,
406	        where:
407	          je.user_id == ^user_id and
408	            je.status == "posted" and
409	            not is_nil(je.category) and
410	            fragment("btrim(?) <> ''", je.category) and
411	            je.date >= ^month_start and
412	            je.date < ^next_month_start,
413	        group_by: fragment("lower(btrim(?))", je.category),
414	        order_by: [desc: sum(je.amount_cents)],
415	        select: %{
416	          category: fragment("lower(btrim(?))", je.category),
417	          total_cents: sum(je.amount_cents),
418	          entry_count: count(je.id)
419	        }
420	      )
421	      |> Repo.all()
422	      |> Enum.map(fn category ->
423	        %{category | category: humanize_category(category.category)}
424	      end)
425	
426	    %{
427	      month_start: month_start,
428	      currency: user.base_currency,
429	      total_cents: Enum.sum_by(categories, & &1.total_cents),
430	      entry_count: Enum.sum_by(categories, & &1.entry_count),
431	      categories: categories
432	    }
433	  end
434	
435	  @doc """
436	  Returns the distinct categories the scoped user has already assigned, sorted
437	  alphabetically, for autocompleting the posting form.
438	
439	  Categories differing only in case or surrounding whitespace collapse into
440	  one suggestion spelled as most recently used. Other users' categories are
441	  never returned.
442	  """
443	  @spec list_categories(Scope.t()) :: [String.t()]
444	  def list_categories(%Scope{user: user}) do
445	    from(je in JournalEntry,
446	      where:
447	        je.user_id == ^user.id and
448	          not is_nil(je.category) and
449	          fragment("btrim(?) <> ''", je.category),
450	      distinct: fragment("lower(btrim(?))", je.category),
451	      # DISTINCT ON keeps the first row per key, so newest first picks the latest spelling.
452	      order_by: [desc: je.updated_at, desc: je.id],
453	      select: fragment("btrim(?)", je.category)
454	    )
455	    |> Repo.all()
456	  end
457	
458	  @spec list_journal_entries(integer()) :: [JournalEntry.t()]
459	  def list_journal_entries(user_id) do
460	    from(je in JournalEntry,
461	      where: je.user_id == ^user_id,
462	      preload: [:tax_deduction_claim],
463	      order_by: [
464	        desc: je.updated_at,
465	        desc: je.id
466	      ]
467	    )
468	    |> Repo.all()
469	  end
470	
471	  @spec get_journal_entry(integer(), integer()) :: {:ok, JournalEntry.t()} | {:error, String.t()}
472	  def get_journal_entry(id, user_id) do
473	    case Repo.one(
474	           from je in JournalEntry,
475	             where: je.id == ^id and je.user_id == ^user_id,
476	             preload: [:tax_deduction_claim]
477	         ) do
478	      nil -> {:error, "Journal entry not found or not owned by user"}
479	      entry -> {:ok, entry}
480	    end
481	  end
482	
483	  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
484	  # Private helpers
485	  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
486	
487	  defp humanize_category(category) do
488	    category
489	    |> String.split(~r/\s+/, trim: true)
490	    |> Enum.map_join(" ", &capitalize_word/1)
491	  end
492	
493	  defp capitalize_word(word) do
494	    case String.next_grapheme(word) do
495	      {first, rest} -> String.upcase(first) <> rest
496	      nil -> word
497	    end
498	  end
499	
500	  defp parse_date(nil), do: nil
501	
502	  defp parse_date(str) when is_binary(str) do
503	    case Date.from_iso8601(str) do
504	      {:ok, date} -> date
505	      {:error, _} -> nil
506	    end
507	  end
508	
509	  defp upsert_tax_deduction_claim(repo, %JournalEntry{} = entry, attrs) do
510	    attrs = normalize_tax_claim_attrs(entry.amount_cents, attrs)
511	
512	    case repo.get_by(TaxDeductionClaim, journal_entry_id: entry.id) do
513	      nil ->
514	        TaxDeductionClaim.changeset_for_create(entry, attrs) |> repo.insert()
515	
516	      claim ->
517	        TaxDeductionClaim.changeset_for_update(claim, attrs) |> repo.update()
518	    end
519	  end
520	
521	  defp normalize_tax_claim_attrs(amount_cents, attrs) do
522	    attrs = Map.new(attrs, fn {key, value} -> {to_string(key), value} end)
523	    status = Map.get(attrs, "status", "undecided")
524	
525	    Map.put_new_lazy(attrs, "deductible_amount_cents", fn ->
526	      if status in ["not_deductible", "disallowed"], do: 0, else: amount_cents
527	    end)
528	  end
529	
530	  @doc """
531	  Builds the `journal_entry_posted` audit event for a booked `entry`.
532	
533	  Every way of booking an entry writes this event in the booking's transaction.
534	  `details` adds path-specific metadata, such as how a backfill chose the values.
535	  """
536	  @spec posted_event_changeset(JournalEntry.t(), String.t() | nil, map()) :: Ecto.Changeset.t()
537	  def posted_event_changeset(%JournalEntry{} = entry, tax_status, details \\ %{}) do
538	    EventLog.changeset_for_create(%{
539	      event_type: "journal_entry_posted",
540	      invoice_id: to_string(entry.id),
541	      user_id: entry.user_id,
542	      status: "completed",
543	      metadata:
544	        Map.merge(details, %{
545	          category: entry.category,
546	          need_or_want: entry.need_or_want,
547	          tax_deduction_status: tax_status
548	        })
549	    })
550	  end
551	end
