defmodule ZaimuTomo.Accounts do
  @moduledoc """
  The Accounts context.
  """

  import Ecto.Query, warn: false

  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo

  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounts.{User, UserNotifier, UserToken}

  ## Database getters

  @doc """
  Gets a user by email.

  ## Examples

      iex> get_user_by_email("foo@example.com")
      %User{}

      iex> get_user_by_email("unknown@example.com")
      nil

  """
  def get_user_by_email(email) when is_binary(email) do
    Repo.get_by(User, email: email)
  end

  @doc """
  Gets a user by email and password.

  ## Examples

      iex> get_user_by_email_and_password("foo@example.com", "correct_password")
      %User{}

      iex> get_user_by_email_and_password("foo@example.com", "invalid_password")
      nil

  """
  def get_user_by_email_and_password(email, password)
      when is_binary(email) and is_binary(password) do
    user = Repo.get_by(User, email: email)
    if User.valid_password?(user, password), do: user
  end

  @doc """
  Gets a single user.

  Raises `Ecto.NoResultsError` if the User does not exist.

  ## Examples

      iex> get_user!(123)
      %User{}

      iex> get_user!(456)
      ** (Ecto.NoResultsError)

  """
  def get_user!(id), do: Repo.get!(User, id)

  ## User registration

  @doc """
  Registers a user.

  ## Examples

      iex> register_user(%{field: value})
      {:ok, %User{}}

      iex> register_user(%{field: bad_value})
      {:error, %Ecto.Changeset{}}

  """
  def register_user(attrs) do
    %User{}
    |> User.email_changeset(attrs)
    |> Repo.insert()
  end

  ## Settings

  @doc """
  Checks whether the user is in sudo mode.

  The user is in sudo mode when the last authentication was done no further
  than 20 minutes ago. The limit can be given as second argument in minutes.
  """
  def sudo_mode?(user, minutes \\ -20)

  def sudo_mode?(%User{authenticated_at: ts}, minutes) when is_struct(ts, DateTime) do
    DateTime.after?(ts, DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.add(minutes, :minute))
  end

  def sudo_mode?(_user, _minutes), do: false

  @doc """
  Returns an `%Ecto.Changeset{}` for changing the user email.

  See `ZaimuTomo.Accounts.User.email_changeset/3` for a list of supported options.

  ## Examples

      iex> change_user_email(user)
      %Ecto.Changeset{data: %User{}}

  """
  def change_user_email(user, attrs \\ %{}, opts \\ []) do
    User.email_changeset(user, attrs, opts)
  end

  @doc """
  Updates the user email using the given token.

  If the token matches, the user email is updated and the token is deleted.
  """
  def update_user_email(user, token) do
    context = "change:#{user.email}"

    Repo.transact(fn ->
      with {:ok, query} <- UserToken.verify_change_email_token_query(token, context),
           %UserToken{sent_to: email} <- Repo.one(query),
           {:ok, user} <- Repo.update(User.email_changeset(user, %{email: email})),
           {_count, _result} <-
             Repo.delete_all(from(UserToken, where: [user_id: ^user.id, context: ^context])) do
        {:ok, user}
      else
        _ -> {:error, :transaction_aborted}
      end
    end)
  end

  @doc """
  Returns an `%Ecto.Changeset{}` for changing the user password.

  See `ZaimuTomo.Accounts.User.password_changeset/3` for a list of supported options.

  ## Examples

      iex> change_user_password(user)
      %Ecto.Changeset{data: %User{}}

  """
  def change_user_password(user, attrs \\ %{}, opts \\ []) do
    User.password_changeset(user, attrs, opts)
  end

  @doc """
  Updates the user password.

  Returns a tuple with the updated user, as well as a list of expired tokens.

  ## Examples

      iex> update_user_password(user, %{password: REDACTED
      {:ok, {%User{}, [...]}}

      iex> update_user_password(user, %{password: "REDACTED"})
      {:error, %Ecto.Changeset{}}

  """
  def update_user_password(user, attrs) do
    user
    |> User.password_changeset(attrs)
    |> update_user_and_delete_all_tokens()
  end

  @doc """
  Returns an `%Ecto.Changeset{}` for updating the user profile
  (display name and base currency).

  ## Examples

      iex> change_user_profile(user)
      %Ecto.Changeset{data: %User{}}

  """
  def change_user_profile(user, attrs \\ %{}) do
    User.profile_changeset(user, attrs)
  end

  @doc """
  Updates the user profile (display name and base currency).

  ## Examples

      iex> update_user_profile(user, %{display_name: "Sora", base_currency: "CHF"})
      {:ok, %User{}}

      iex> update_user_profile(user, %{base_currency: "Nope"})
      {:error, %Ecto.Changeset{}}

  """
  def update_user_profile(user, attrs) do
    user
    |> User.profile_changeset(attrs)
    |> Repo.update()
  end

  ## Session

  @doc """
  Generates a session token.
  """
  def generate_user_session_token(user) do
    {token, user_token} = UserToken.build_session_token(user)
    Repo.insert!(user_token)
    token
  end

  @doc """
  Gets the user with the given signed token.

  If the token is valid `{user, token_inserted_at}` is returned, otherwise `nil` is returned.
  """
  def get_user_by_session_token(token) do
    {:ok, query} = UserToken.verify_session_token_query(token)
    Repo.one(query)
  end

  @doc """
  Gets the user with the given magic link token.
  """
  def get_user_by_magic_link_token(token) do
    with {:ok, query} <- UserToken.verify_magic_link_token_query(token),
         {user, _token} <- Repo.one(query) do
      user
    else
      _ -> nil
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Logs the user in by magic link.

  There are three cases to consider:

  1. The user has already confirmed their email. They are logged in
     and the magic link is expired.

  2. The user has not confirmed their email and no password is set.
     In this case, the user gets confirmed, logged in, and all tokens -
     including session ones - are expired. In theory, no other tokens
     exist but we delete all of them for best security practices.

  3. The user has not confirmed their email but a password is set.
     This cannot happen in the default implementation but may be the
     source of security pitfalls. See the "Mixing magic link and password registration" section of
     `mix help phx.gen.auth`.
  """
  def login_user_by_magic_link(token) do
    {:ok, query} = UserToken.verify_magic_link_token_query(token)

    case Repo.one(query) do
      # Prevent session fixation attacks by disallowing magic links for unconfirmed users with password
      {%User{confirmed_at: nil, hashed_password: hash}, _token} when not is_nil(hash) ->
        raise """
        magic link log in is not allowed for unconfirmed users with a password set!

        This cannot happen with the default implementation, which indicates that you
        might have adapted the code to a different use case. Please make sure to read the
        "Mixing magic link and password registration" section of `mix help phx.gen.auth`.
        """

      {%User{confirmed_at: nil} = user, _token} ->
        user
        |> User.confirm_changeset()
        |> update_user_and_delete_all_tokens()

      {user, token} ->
        Repo.delete!(token)
        {:ok, {user, []}}

      nil ->
        {:error, :not_found}
    end
  end

  @doc ~S"""
  Delivers the update email instructions to the given user.

  ## Examples

      iex> deliver_user_update_email_instructions(user, current_email, &url(~p"/users/settings/confirm-email/#{&1}"))
      {:ok, %{to: ..., body: ...}}

  """
  def deliver_user_update_email_instructions(%User{} = user, current_email, update_email_url_fun)
      when is_function(update_email_url_fun, 1) do
    {encoded_token, user_token} = UserToken.build_email_token(user, "change:#{current_email}")

    Repo.insert!(user_token)
    UserNotifier.deliver_update_email_instructions(user, update_email_url_fun.(encoded_token))
  end

  @doc """
  Delivers the magic link login instructions to the given user.
  """
  def deliver_login_instructions(%User{} = user, magic_link_url_fun)
      when is_function(magic_link_url_fun, 1) do
    {encoded_token, user_token} = UserToken.build_email_token(user, "login")
    Repo.insert!(user_token)
    UserNotifier.deliver_login_instructions(user, magic_link_url_fun.(encoded_token))
  end

  @doc """
  Deletes the signed token with the given context.
  """
  def delete_user_session_token(token) do
    Repo.delete_all(from(UserToken, where: [token: ^token, context: "session"]))
    :ok
  end

  ## Token helper

  defp update_user_and_delete_all_tokens(changeset) do
    Repo.transact(fn ->
      with {:ok, user} <- Repo.update(changeset) do
        tokens_to_expire = Repo.all_by(UserToken, user_id: user.id)

        Repo.delete_all(from(t in UserToken, where: t.id in ^Enum.map(tokens_to_expire, & &1.id)))

        {:ok, {user, tokens_to_expire}}
      end
    end)
  end
end

defmodule ZaimuTomo.Documents.Document do
  use Ecto.Schema
  import Ecto.Changeset

  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent
  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Fingerprint

  schema "documents" do
    field :filename, :string
    field :object_key, :string
    # Fingerprint of the bytes at `object_key`; nil for legacy rows until the
    # backfill reads them. Redacted so it never reaches logs.
    field :content_sha256, :string, redact: true
    field :user_id, :id

    has_many :extracted_content, ExtractedContent

    timestamps(type: :utc_datetime)
  end

  @type t :: %__MODULE__{}

  @doc false
  def changeset(document, attrs, user_scope) do
    document
    |> cast(attrs, [:filename, :object_key, :content_sha256])
    |> validate_required([:filename, :object_key])
    |> validate_format(:content_sha256, Fingerprint.format())
    |> clear_stale_fingerprint()
    |> put_change(:user_id, user_scope.user.id)
    |> foreign_key_constraint(:user_id)
  end

  # The digest describes the bytes at `object_key`. Replacing the object
  # without a new digest must not leave the old file's digest behind.
  defp clear_stale_fingerprint(changeset) do
    if changed?(changeset, :object_key) and not changed?(changeset, :content_sha256) do
      put_change(changeset, :content_sha256, nil)
    else
      changeset
    end
  end
end

defmodule ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContentContext do
  @moduledoc """
  Context for managing extracted content from OCR/LLM processing.
  """

  import Ecto.Query
  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent
  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo

  @doc """
  Creates a new extracted content record.

  ## Parameters
    - attrs: Map containing extracted content data

  ## Returns
    - {:ok, %ExtractedContent{}} on success
    - {:error, changeset} on validation error
  """
  def create_extracted_content(attrs) do
    %ExtractedContent{}
    |> ExtractedContent.changeset(attrs)
    |> Repo.insert()
  end

  @doc """
  Gets extracted content by ID.

  ## Parameters
    - extraction_id: ID of the extracted content record

  ## Returns
    - %ExtractedContent{} or nil
  """
  def get_by_id(extraction_id) do
    query =
      from ec in ExtractedContent,
        where: ec.id == ^extraction_id,
        limit: 1

    Repo.one(query)
  end

  @doc """
  Persists a TypeSafe shadow result without replacing authoritative verification.
  """
  @spec put_typesafe_shadow(pos_integer(), map()) ::
          {:ok, ExtractedContent.t()} | {:error, term()}
  def put_typesafe_shadow(extraction_id, shadow) when is_map(shadow) do
    case get_by_id(extraction_id) do
      %ExtractedContent{} = content ->
        analysis = content.analysis || %{}
        verification = Map.get(analysis, "verification", %{})

        updated_analysis =
          Map.put(analysis, "verification", Map.put(verification, "typesafe_shadow", shadow))

        content
        |> Ecto.Changeset.change(analysis: updated_analysis)
        |> Repo.update()

      nil ->
        {:error, :extracted_content_not_found}
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Gets the latest extraction for a document.

  ## Parameters
    - document_id: ID of the document

  ## Returns
    - %ExtractedContent{} or nil
  """
  def get_latest_by_document(document_id) do
    query =
      from ec in ExtractedContent,
        where: ec.document_id == ^document_id,
        order_by: [desc: :inserted_at, desc: :id],
        limit: 1

    Repo.one(query)
  end

  def get_structured_data(content) when is_map(content) do
    # extracted_data is already a struct, just return it
    {:ok, content.extracted_data}
  end

  def get_response_data(content) do
    # Convert struct to map for API responses
    Map.from_struct(content.extracted_data)
  end

  def get_analysis(content) do
    content.analysis || %{}
  end

  # Combined response with data and analysis
  def get_full_response(content) do
    %{
      "data" => get_response_data(content),
      "analysis" => get_analysis(content),
      "status" => content.status,
      "extracted_at" => content.inserted_at
    }
  end

  # Get specific fields with type safety
  def get_invoice_amount(content) do
    content.extracted_data.amount_to_pay_cents
  end

  def get_invoice_date(content) do
    content.extracted_data.invoice_date
  end

  def get_invoice_number(content) do
    content.extracted_data.invoice_number
  end
end

1	defmodule ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ErrorClassification do
2	  @moduledoc """
3	  Pure classification of document-processing failure reasons by retryability.
4	
5	  The OCR pipeline emits a variety of error shapes (storage, HTTP clients, LLM
6	  wrappers, prompt fetch, persistence). `classify/1` maps each to:
7	
8	    * `:transient` — worth retrying (rate limits, outages, network/fs blips).
9	      The job returns `{:error, reason}` WITHOUT persisting; Oban backs off and
10	      retries, and persists a single failed row only on the final attempt.
11	
12	    * `:permanent` — retrying cannot help (bad request, missing config, invalid
13	      payload, missing bytes). The job persists one failed row and completes.
14	
15	  Classification is pattern-matched on the exact shapes the pipeline emits (see
16	  `ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.Worker.run/1`). It fails closed to `:permanent`
17	  for unrecognized non-atom shapes so a new bug never silently multiplies
18	  retries. Bare atoms are fail-closed too: only the explicitly listed
19	  POSIX/filesystem atoms below are `:transient`; every other atom is
20	  `:permanent`.
21	
22	  `summarize/1` renders a bounded, body-free error class for Oban error
23	  history and logs, so raw provider response bodies never reach `oban_jobs`.
24	  """
25	
26	  @type class :: :transient | :permanent
27	
28	  # Storage / OCR / prompt: 408, 429 and 5xx are transient (rate limit/outage).
29	  @transient_statuses [408, 429]
30	  # The extractor LLM additionally treats 409/425 as transient (provider busy).
31	  @transient_llm_statuses [408, 409, 425, 429]
32	  @transient_status_max 500
33	
34	  # Filesystem/transport atoms worth retrying (disk full, I/O blips, fs
35	  # pressure, network resets). Every other bare atom is permanent.
36	  @transient_posix [
37	    :enospc,
38	    :eio,
39	    :eagain,
40	    :ebusy,
41	    :etimedout,
42	    :econnrefused,
43	    :econnreset,
44	    :ehostunreach,
45	    :enetunreach,
46	    :emfile,
47	    :enfile
48	  ]
49	
50	  # Bare atoms emitted by the OCR, prompt, extractor and verifier stages (not
51	  # storage), all permanent.
52	  @pipeline_atoms [
53	    :unexpected_api_structure,
54	    :missing_structured_output,
55	    :invalid_extraction_payload,
56	    :langfuse_prompt_api_not_configured,
57	    :invalid_langfuse_prompt_response,
58	    :prompt_fetcher_failed
59	  ]
60	
61	  @doc """
62	  Classify a processing failure `reason` as `:transient` or `:permanent`.
63	  """
64	  @spec classify(term()) :: class()
65	
66	  # -- Scratch / temporary file ------------------------------------------
67	  # Disk full or a tmp blip: retry.
68	  def classify({:scratch_unavailable, _posix}), do: :transient
69	
70	  # -- Storage (S3 / memory) --------------------------------------------
71	  # Store overloaded or down (408/429/5xx).
72	  def classify({:unexpected_status, status}) when status in @transient_statuses,
73	    do: :transient
74	
75	  def classify({:unexpected_status, status}) when status >= @transient_status_max,
76	    do: :transient
77	
78	  # e.g. 403 signature/config, 400 bad request.
79	  def classify({:unexpected_status, _status}), do: :permanent
80	
81	  # -- Prompt fetch (Langfuse) ------------------------------------------
82	  # Langfuse blip: a rate-limit/outage status or a transport error.
83	  def classify({:prompt_fetch_failed, status})
84	      when is_integer(status) and
85	             (status in @transient_statuses or status >= @transient_status_max),
86	      do: :transient
87	
88	  def classify({:prompt_fetch_failed, %Req.TransportError{}}), do: :transient
89	  # Any other prompt failure (config, bad key, malformed prompt) is permanent.
90	  def classify({:prompt_fetch_failed, _other}), do: :permanent
91	  def classify({:local_prompt_not_found, _name}), do: :permanent
92	
93	  # -- Extractor LLM ----------------------------------------------------
94	  # No status means a transport error.
95	  def classify({:llm_request_failed, %{status: nil}}), do: :transient
96	
97	  # Provider / FLM busy.
98	  def classify({:llm_request_failed, %{status: status}})
99	      when status in @transient_llm_statuses or status >= @transient_status_max,
100	      do: :transient
101	
102	  # 400 / 401 / 404 and other non-retryable statuses.
103	  def classify({:llm_request_failed, %{status: _status}}), do: :permanent
104	  def classify({:validation_failed, _errors}), do: :permanent
105	
106	  # -- Mistral OCR ------------------------------------------------------
107	  # Local read of a just-written temp file failing (a bare posix atom) is a bug,
108	  # not a blip. HTTP/upload failures carry an {:http_status, ...} or transport
109	  # detail and are handled by the stage-tagged clauses below.
110	  def classify({:ocr_upload_failed, posix}) when is_atom(posix), do: :permanent
111	
112	  # -- Persistence ------------------------------------------------------
113	  def classify({:persistence_failed, _errors}), do: :permanent
114	
115	  # -- Mistral OCR (stage-tagged detail) --------------------------------
116	  # Rate limit / outage.
117	  def classify({_stage, {:http_status, status, _body}})
118	      when status in @transient_statuses or status >= @transient_status_max,
119	      do: :transient
120	
121	  # Other 4xx: bad request / auth.
122	  def classify({_stage, {:http_status, _status, _body}}), do: :permanent
123	  # Timeout / connection refused.
124	  def classify({_stage, %Req.TransportError{}}), do: :transient
125	  # Missing config; needs a deploy, not a retry.
126	  def classify({_stage, "Missing Mistral API key"}), do: :permanent
127	
128	  # -- Known permanent bare atoms --------------------------------------
129	  # The stored bytes are gone; a retry cannot help.
130	  def classify(:not_found), do: :permanent
131	  # OCR / prompt / extractor / verifier outcomes (unexpected body shape,
132	  # missing or invalid output, prompt config).
133	  def classify(reason) when reason in @pipeline_atoms, do: :permanent
134	
135	  # -- Storage transport (bare posix / transport) ----------------------
136	  # Only the explicitly listed filesystem/transport atoms are retried; every
137	  # other bare atom (a new business/pseudo-error) is fail-closed to permanent.
138	  def classify(%Req.TransportError{}), do: :transient
139	
140	  def classify(reason) when reason in @transient_posix, do: :transient
141	  def classify(reason) when is_atom(reason), do: :permanent
142	
143	  # Fail closed: any unrecognized non-atom shape is permanent so a new bug never
144	  # silently multiplies retries.
145	  def classify(_other), do: :permanent
146	
147	  @doc """
148	  Renders a bounded, body-free summary of a processing failure `reason`.
149	
150	  Provider response bodies and other free-form payloads are never included, so
151	  the result is safe to persist in `oban_jobs.errors` and to log. Unknown
152	  shapes summarize to `"unclassified"`.
153	  """
154	  @spec summarize(term()) :: String.t()
155	
156	  def summarize({stage, {:http_status, status, _body}})
157	      when is_atom(stage) and is_integer(status),
158	      do: "#{stage}:http_#{status}"
159	
160	  def summarize({stage, %Req.TransportError{reason: reason}})
161	      when is_atom(stage) and is_atom(reason),
162	      do: "#{stage}:transport_#{reason}"
163	
164	  def summarize({stage, %Req.TransportError{}}) when is_atom(stage), do: "#{stage}:transport"
165	
166	  def summarize({stage, "Missing Mistral API key"}) when is_atom(stage),
167	    do: "#{stage}:missing_api_key"
168	
169	  def summarize({stage, posix}) when is_atom(stage) and is_atom(posix), do: "#{stage}:#{posix}"
170	
171	  def summarize({:llm_request_failed, %{status: status}}) when is_integer(status),
172	    do: "llm_request_failed:http_#{status}"
173	
174	  def summarize({:llm_request_failed, %{status: nil}}), do: "llm_request_failed:transport"
175	
176	  def summarize({:prompt_fetch_failed, status}) when is_integer(status),
177	    do: "prompt_fetch_failed:http_#{status}"
178	
179	  def summarize({:persistence_failed, _errors}), do: "persistence_failed"
180	  def summarize({:validation_failed, _errors}), do: "validation_failed"
181	  def summarize({:local_prompt_not_found, _name}), do: "local_prompt_not_found"
182	
183	  def summarize(%Req.TransportError{reason: reason}) when is_atom(reason),
184	    do: "storage:transport_#{reason}"
185	
186	  def summarize(%Req.TransportError{}), do: "storage:transport"
187	  def summarize(reason) when reason in @pipeline_atoms, do: Atom.to_string(reason)
188	  def summarize(reason) when is_atom(reason), do: "storage:#{reason}"
189	  def summarize(_other), do: "unclassified"
190	end
191

1	defmodule ZaimuTomo.Application do
2	  # See https://hexdocs.pm/elixir/Application.html
3	  # for more information on OTP Applications
4	  @moduledoc false
5	
6	  use Application
7	
8	  @impl true
9	  def start(_type, _args) do
10	    ZaimuTomo.Langfuse.setup()
11	    ZaimuTomo.ObanFailureLogger.attach()
12	
13	    children =
14	      [
15	        ZaimuTomoWeb.Telemetry,
16	        ZaimuTomo.Repo,
17	        {DNSCluster, query: Application.get_env(:zaimu_tomo, :dns_cluster_query) || :ignore},
18	        {Phoenix.PubSub, name: ZaimuTomo.PubSub},
19	        # Durable job queue. Placed after PubSub so job broadcasts can reach
20	        # connected LiveViews, and before the Endpoint that enqueues on upload.
21	        {Oban, Application.fetch_env!(:zaimu_tomo, Oban)},
22	        # Start a worker by calling: ZaimuTomo.Worker.start_link(arg)
23	        # {ZaimuTomo.Worker, arg},
24	        # Start to serve requests, typically the last entry
25	        ZaimuTomoWeb.Endpoint
26	      ] ++ storage_children()
27	
28	    # See https://hexdocs.pm/elixir/Supervisor.html
29	    # for other strategies and supported options
30	    opts = [strategy: :one_for_one, name: ZaimuTomo.Supervisor]
31	    Supervisor.start_link(children, opts)
32	  end
33	
34	  # Tell Phoenix to update the endpoint configuration
35	  # whenever the application is updated.
36	  @impl true
37	  def config_change(changed, _new, removed) do
38	    ZaimuTomoWeb.Endpoint.config_change(changed, removed)
39	    :ok
40	  end
41	
42	  defp storage_children do
43	    case Application.fetch_env!(:zaimu_tomo, :storage) |> Keyword.fetch!(:adapter) do
44	      ZaimuTomo.Storage.Memory -> [ZaimuTomo.Storage.Memory]
45	      _adapter -> []
46	    end
47	  end
48	end

10	    field :object_key, :string
11	    # Fingerprint of the bytes at `object_key`; nil for legacy rows until the
12	    # backfill reads them. Redacted so it never reaches logs.
13	    field :content_sha256, :string, redact: true
14	    field :user_id, :id
15	
16	    has_many :extracted_content, ExtractedContent

21	  @type t :: %__MODULE__{}
22	
23	  @doc false
24	  def changeset(document, attrs, user_scope) do
25	    document
26	    |> cast(attrs, [:filename, :object_key, :content_sha256])
27	    |> validate_required([:filename, :object_key])
28	    |> validate_format(:content_sha256, Fingerprint.format())
29	    |> clear_stale_fingerprint()

32	  end

34	  # The digest describes the bytes at `object_key`. Replacing the object
35	  # without a new digest must not leave the old file's digest behind.
36	  defp clear_stale_fingerprint(changeset) do
37	    if changed?(changeset, :object_key) and not changed?(changeset, :content_sha256) do
38	      put_change(changeset, :content_sha256, nil)
39	    else
40	      changeset
41	    end
42	  end

defp conditional_lock_for_migrations(module, version, repo, opts, fun) do
    lock = if module.__migration__()[:disable_migration_lock], do: false, else: version
    lock_for_migrations(lock, repo, opts, fun)
  end

  defp pending_to(versions, migration_source, direction, target) when is_integer(target) do
    within_target_version? = fn
      {version, _, _}, target, :up ->
        version <= target

      {version, _, _}, target, :down ->
        version >= target
    end

    pending_in_direction(versions, migration_source, direction)
    |> Enum.take_while(&within_target_version?.(&1, target, direction))
  end

  defp pending_to_exclusive(versions, migration_source, direction, target)
       when is_integer(target) do
    within_target_version? = fn
      {version, _, _}, target, :up ->
        version < target

      {version, _, _}, target, :down ->
        version > target
    end

    pending_in_direction(versions, migration_source, direction)
    |> Enum.take_while(&within_target_version?.(&1, target, direction))
  end

  defp pending_step(versions, migration_source, direction, count) do
    pending_in_direction(versions, migration_source, direction)
    |> Enum.take(count)
  end

  defp pending_all(versions, migration_source, direction) do
    pending_in_direction(versions, migration_source, direction)
  end

  defp pending_in_direction(versions, migration_source, :up) do
    migration_source
    |> migrations_for()
    |> Enum.filter(fn {version, _name, _file} -> version not in versions end)
  end

  defp pending_in_direction(versions, migration_source, :down) do
    migration_source
    |> migrations_for()
    |> Enum.filter(fn {version, _name, _file} -> version in versions end)
    |> Enum.reverse()
  end

  defp migrations_for(migration_source) when is_list(migration_source) do
    migration_source
    |> Enum.flat_map(fn
      directory when is_binary(directory) ->
        Path.join([directory, "**", "*.{ex,exs}"])
        |> Path.wildcard()
        |> Enum.map(&extract_migration_info/1)

367	## 9. Architecture decisions
368	
369	Short decision records, newest last. Add one when a change alters structure,
370	infrastructure, or a cross-cutting rule. Older, longer feature-level reasoning
371	is in [`specs/`](../specs/README.md).
372	
373	| # | Date | Decision | Why / consequences |
374	|---|---|---|---|
375	| D1 | 2026-01 | Phoenix LiveView monolith with phx.gen.auth scopes | One deployable, server-rendered real-time UI. All data is scoped per user. |
376	| D2 | 2026-03 | Persist every extraction attempt as a row; one review decision per extraction | Keeps history, and humans approve before booking. See `specs/001`, `specs/002`. |
377	| D3 | 2026-05 | Journal entries only from approved or amended decisions | AI never writes to the books directly. |
378	| D4 | 2026-06 | Kamal 2 on a single VPS, app reachable only over WireGuard | Low cost, private by default. Postgres runs as a Kamal accessory. |
379	| D5 | 2026-08 | Per-role LLM backends (extractor and verifier) selected by env, with no fallback | Models can be swapped or mixed (local and cloud) without code changes. Misconfiguration fails loudly. |
380	| D6 | 2026-08 | Document bytes in S3-compatible storage (self-hosted RustFS), with a provider-neutral `Storage` facade | Decouples bytes from the release. A later provider switch is config only. See `specs/003`. |
381	| D7 | 2026-09 | TypeSafe Jev as a *shadow* verifier | Collects independent per-field error probabilities without affecting outcomes until it is trusted. |
382	| D8 | 2026-09 | Replace fire-and-forget `Task` OCR with durable Oban jobs, enqueued in the upload transaction | Uploads can't lose their job. Retries, Lifeline rescue, user retry, and operator recovery. The TypeSafe shadow also moved to Oban. |
383	| D9 | 2026-10 | Add `stream_data` (test-only) for property-based tests on pure, boundary-heavy logic (currency normalization, error-retry classification, changeset validity, aggregation sums) | Generates and shrinks adversarial inputs instead of relying only on hand-picked examples; already caught an Ecto blank-string edge case in `Currency.normalize_and_validate/2`. 384	| D10 | 2026-08 | Duplicate invoice detection: DB-enforced unique index, plus the journal entry in the same transaction as the review decision | A numbered invoice (same user, issuer, invoice number) cannot post twice; the database enforces it regardless of code path. An unnumbered exact `(issuer, date, amount, currency)` match warns and needs explicit confirmation. Posting the journal entry, tax claim, and event log now happens in the same `Ecto.Multi` as the decision update, so a duplicate or a failed audit write rolls the whole transition back — closing the gap in §11. |
385	| D11 | 2026-10 | Exact-byte SHA-256 fingerprints as an OCR-independent duplicate signal, copied to the journal entry at posting and enforced by a per-user partial unique index over unconfirmed postings | Re-uploading identical bytes is caught even when OCR/LLM reads different fields. A unique constraint cannot span document → extraction → review → entry, so the digest is snapshotted on the entry. Legitimately reused files (QR-bills, standing slips) post only with an explicit per-posting confirmation, recorded on the entry and in the event log. Legacy rows are filled by an online, idempotent backfill through the `Storage` facade, never by a migration. See `specs/004`. |
386	| D12 | 2026-10 | Upgrade to Elixir 1.20 (OTP unchanged at 28) | Elixir 1.20 completes zero-annotation type inference across all constructs, so the existing `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` CI gate now also catches unreachable clauses and dead code for free, no specs or Dialyzer required. First step toward the CI reliability work tracked for direct-to-main pushes; a complementary nightly Dialyzer job (whole-program success typing) is still planned separately. |
387	| D13 | 2026-10 | Split CI into `lint` / `test` / `security-audit` jobs; `mix credo --strict` and `mix hex.audit` run on every push but are advisory (non-blocking), with a separate nightly workflow re-running the audit so a CVE disclosed on a quiet day still gets caught | First step of hardening CI as the real safety net for pushing straight to `main` with less manual review. 388	| D14 | 2026-10 | Add Dialyzer (dialyxir) as a nightly, advisory-only CI job rather than a required per-push check | Whole-program success typing complements the Elixir 1.20 compiler's own type inference (D12) by also checking across the OTP/dependency boundary, but PLT builds are too slow for a per-push gate. 389	| D15 | 2026-10 | Clear the 51-finding Credo backlog and make `mix credo --strict` blocking in the existing `lint` CI job | Supersedes D13's advisory Credo policy so new findings fail CI instead of rebuilding the backlog. Reorder aliases, alias nested module calls, use implicit function-level rescue/catch and readable string sigils, use `ReviewDecision.t()` in specs, and configure the existing TypeSafe Logger metadata explicitly. 390	| D16 | 2026-10 | Pin every workflow job to `runs-on: ubuntu-26.04` instead of `ubuntu-latest` | GitHub migrated the `ubuntu-latest` label from Ubuntu 24.04 to 26.04 gradually between October 19 and November 19, 2026, so two runs of the same commit could land on different images with no repo change. 395	## 10. Quality requirements
396	
397	| Scenario | Expected behaviour |
398	|---|---|
399	| The app is redeployed while a document is being processed | Lifeline rescues the job and the document is processed exactly once (no duplicate terminal rows). |
400	| The LLM provider returns 429 or 5xx | Retried with backoff up to 5 attempts, then one visible failure the user can retry. |
401	| TypeSafe is down or slow | Extraction is unaffected. The shadow result records a failure. |
402	| A user opens another user's document ID | Not found (scoped query). |
403	| The VPS is lost | Restore from the off-host object export plus the Postgres dump, then `bin/verify_storage` reports zero missing objects. |
404	| Switching the LLM model | Env change and redeploy only. |
405	| The same file is uploaded and approved twice concurrently | At most one journal entry commits (unique index); the other review rolls back and stays pending. |

409	## 11. Risks and technical debt
410	
411	| Item | Notes |
412	|---|---|
413	| Legacy upload volume | `zaimu_tomo_uploads` is still mounted (`config/deploy.yml`, `Dockerfile`) from the pre-S3 migration. Remove it after the restore check is recorded (see [operations.md](operations.md#legacy-upload-volume)). |
414	| Single host | App, DB, and object store share one VPS. Backups are the only DR mechanism. |
415	| No production mailer | `runtime.exs` configures no Swoosh adapter for prod, so email-based auth flows (confirmation, magic links) don't deliver in production. |
416	| Shared S3 credential | The app's S3 key is the RustFS root credential. Per-application credentials are not yet introduced. |
417	| `force_ssl` off | HTTP behind the VPN is by design. Enable `FORCE_SSL` at build time if the app is ever exposed publicly. |
418	| Fingerprint coverage of legacy postings | Exact-file protection covers historical entries only after `bin/backfill_document_fingerprints` reports complete coverage. Missing objects and unresolved same-user collisions stay null and are not protected (see [operations.md](operations.md#document-fingerprint-backfill)). |
419	| Confirmed reuses are not DB-constrained | A confirmed file reuse is excluded from the unique index; the "no field match" condition is checked in the posting transaction, not by a constraint, so two simultaneous postings by the same user could both pass it. |
420	| Temporary test-only `hackney` override | Testcontainers 2.4.0 requires vulnerable Hackney 1.x. A test-only `~> 4.9` override keeps it on the patched line; the locked Tesla 1.21.2 supports Hackney 4.x. Hackney remains excluded from production, but its required IDNA 7.1 upgrade is shared with production's JSV and Swoosh dependencies, whose constraints allow it. Remove the override once a published Testcontainers release includes [upstream's Hackney 4 support](https://github.com/testcontainers/testcontainers-elixir/commit/f73bac030ffa40beb34793470d8d29d56ad4b03c), preserving a patched lockfile. Validate Docker compatibility with `RUN_INTEGRATION=true mix test test/zaimu_tomo/storage/rustfs_integration_test.exs` when updating this dependency. |
421	| Hackney 4 Unix-socket pooling | Hackney 4.8.5's default pool replaces the Unix-socket transport with TCP, producing `:nxdomain` for Testcontainers' Docker socket path. `config/test.exs` disables Hackney's default pool so Docker requests retain their Unix-socket transport. Remove this test-only workaround once a fixed Hackney release passes the RustFS integration tests with pooling enabled. |
422	| Resolved dependency advisories (2026-10-26) | ReqLLM 1.29.0 fixes WebSocket TLS verification (CVE-2026-107685); Plug.Crypto 2.2.1 fixes secret-bearing stack traces (CVE-2026-105963). Both advisories were published after the successful October 23 nightly audit. Bandit 1.14.0 and test-only Hackney 4.9.1 also resolve the advisories published later on October 26. Direct dependency requirements exclude the vulnerable lines; `mix.lock` pins the patched transitive Plug.Crypto release. Keep running `MIX_ENV=test mix hex.audit`: a green overall CI result does not guarantee a clean audit because the per-push security job is advisory. |
423	| Resolved TLS hostname advisory (2026-10-30) | `mix.lock` pins `ssl_verify_fun` 1.1.8 to fix [CVE-2026-117666](https://cna.erlef.org/cves/CVE-2026-117666.html), which let partial-label wildcards span DNS labels and wildcard DNS names match IP literals. It is a production dependency through OpenTelemetry Exporter → `tls_certificate_check`, and a test dependency through Hackney. Both parents' existing constraints accept the patch, so no override is needed. Their default SNI and OTP hostname checks mitigate this flaw on OTP 28; retain those checks rather than relying solely on the library callback. |
424	| Resolved HTML attribute and JSON Schema advisories (2026-11-03) | Phoenix.HTML 4.4.0 fixes attribute injection through unvalidated attribute names ([CVE-2026-117645](https://cna.erlef.org/cves/CVE-2026-117645.html)); the direct `~> 4.4` requirement excludes vulnerable releases. `mix.lock` pins JSV 0.26.2 to fix regex-budget exhaustion being treated as a non-match, bypassing JSON Schema validation ([CVE-2026-117680](https://cna.erlef.org/cves/CVE-2026-117680.html)). ReqLLM's existing JSV constraint accepts the patch, so no override or new direct dependency is needed. |

An unnumbered exact `(issuer, date, amount, currency)` match warns and needs explicit confirmation. Posting the journal entry, tax claim, and event log now happens in the same `Ecto.Multi` as the decision update, so a duplicate or a failed audit write rolls the whole transition back — closing the gap in §11. |
| D11 | 2026-10 | Exact-byte SHA-256 fingerprints as an OCR-independent duplicate signal, copied to the journal entry at posting and enforced by a per-user partial unique index over unconfirmed postings | Re-uploading identical bytes is caught even when OCR/LLM reads different fields. A unique constraint cannot span document → extraction → review → entry, so the digest is snapshotted on the entry. Legitimately reused files (QR-bills, standing slips) post only with an explicit per-posting confirmation, recorded on the entry and in the event log. Legacy rows are filled by an online, idempotent backfill through the `Storage` facade, never by a migration. See `specs/004`. |
| D12 | 2026-10 | Upgrade to Elixir 1.20 (OTP unchanged at 28) | Elixir 1.20 completes zero-annotation type inference across all constructs, so the existing `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` CI gate now also catches unreachable clauses and dead code for free, no specs or Dialyzer required. Surfaced and removed 3 pre-existing dead branches (`review.ex`, `llm_client.ex`, `langfuse.ex`) that the 1.19 compiler couldn't see. First step toward the CI reliability work tracked for direct-to-main pushes; a complementary nightly Dialyzer job (whole-program success typing) is still planned separately. |
| D13 | 2026-10 | Split CI into `lint` / `test` / `security-audit` jobs; `mix credo --strict` and `mix hex.audit` run on every push but are advisory (non-blocking), with a separate nightly workflow re-running the audit so a CVE disclosed on a quiet day still gets caught | First step of hardening CI as the real safety net for pushing straight to `main` with less manual review. Credo and the audit aren't required checks yet because both already have a pre-existing backlog (51 Credo issues; `hackney` pinned to a vulnerable 1.x line by a test-only dependency) unrelated to any one change — see §11. `mix hex.audit` found 6 live advisories in locked dependencies; the `bandit` ones were fixed by a routine version bump in the same change, `hackney`'s needs a dependency change tracked separately. |
| D14 | 2026-10 | Add Dialyzer (dialyxir) as a nightly, advisory-only CI job rather than a required per-push check | Whole-program success typing complements the Elixir 1.20 compiler's own type inference (D12) by also checking across the OTP/dependency boundary, but PLT builds are too slow for a per-push gate. First run found 10 findings: 3 duplicated dead code already fixed by the Elixir 1.20 upgrade; 5 are a well-known Dialyzer/`Ecto.Multi` opaque-`MapSet` false positive; 2 (`storage/s3.ex`) are a `File.stream!/2` success-typing gap verified benign directly in `iex` before suppressing. All 7 non-duplicate false positives are listed individually in `.dialyzer_ignore.exs` with the reasoning, not blanket-ignored, so a genuinely new finding in the same file still surfaces. Also added missing `@type t :: %__MODULE__{}` to `ExtractedData` and `ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent` (matching the convention already used in `Document`/`ReviewDecision`), which cleared 9 separate `unknown_type` findings and makes every existing `@spec` referencing them actually checked going forward. |
| D15 | 2026-10 | Clear the 51-finding Credo backlog and make `mix credo --strict` blocking in the existing `lint` CI job | Supersedes D13's advisory Credo policy so new findings fail CI instead of rebuilding the backlog. Reorder aliases, alias nested module calls, use implicit function-level rescue/catch and readable string sigils, use `ReviewDecision.t()` in specs, and configure the existing TypeSafe Logger metadata explicitly. The two upload-test TODOs were stale: the same file already exercises uploads and edit submission, so replace them with references to that coverage. No checks are disabled and no findings are suppressed. Security audit and nightly Dialyzer remain advisory; GitHub branch protection settings are unchanged. |
| D16 | 2026-10 | Pin every workflow job to `runs-on: ubuntu-26.04` instead of `ubuntu-latest` | GitHub migrated the `ubuntu-latest` label from Ubuntu 24.04 to 26.04 gradually between October 19 and November 19, 2026, so two runs of the same commit could land on different images with no repo change. Pinning makes the toolchain that a green build was verified against explicit and reproducible, and turns the next image adoption into a deliberate commit rather than a silent rollover. `ubuntu-26.04` is GA on x64, and all five jobs only need Docker, the Postgres service container, and `erlef/setup-beam`'s Elixir/OTP builds, which the new image supports. |
| D17 | 2026-11 | One invoice page (`/documents/:id`) replaces the review, amend, and journal-entry posting screens, so it is the only place an entry is booked; checking and booking are one transaction. `/documents/:id/edit` remains and only replaces the stored file | The flow split one invoice over three pages that did not link to each other, so a treated or amended invoice was hard to find again. `Review.approve_invoice/4` and `amend_invoice/5` take `:booking` and `:tax_claim_attrs`, and `Accounting.create_multi_from_decision/3` posts the entry inside the existing review transaction, so a booking error rolls back the whole posting like a duplicate does. One comment per invoice (stored as review notes and copied to the entry's notes). Extraction feedback is sent automatically on posting so Langfuse gets a signal for every posted invoice. A rejection sends a score only when the user picked 👍/👎, because a correctly read duplicate is rejected too. |

---

## 10. Quality requirements

| Scenario | Expected behaviour |
|---|---|
| The app is redeployed while a document is being processed | Lifeline rescues the job and the document is processed exactly once (no duplicate terminal rows). |
| The LLM provider returns 429 or 5xx | Retried with backoff up to 5 attempts, then one visible failure the user can retry. |
| TypeSafe is down or slow | Extraction is unaffected. The shadow result records a failure. |
| A user opens another user's document ID | Not found (scoped query). |
| The VPS is lost | Restore from the off-host object export plus the Postgres dump, then `bin/verify_storage` reports zero missing objects. |
| Switching the LLM model | Env change and redeploy only. |
| The same file is uploaded and approved twice concurrently | At most one journal entry commits (unique index); the other review rolls back and stays pending. |

---

## 11. Risks and technical debt

| Item | Notes |
|---|---|
| Legacy upload volume | `zaimu_tomo_uploads` is still mounted (`config/deploy.yml`, `Dockerfile`) from the pre-S3 migration. Remove it after the restore check is recorded (see [operations.md](operations.md#legacy-upload-volume)). |
| Single host | App, DB, and object store share one VPS. Backups are the only DR mechanism. |
| No production mailer | `runtime.exs` configures no Swoosh adapter for prod, so email-based auth flows (confirmation, magic links) don't deliver in production. |
| Shared S3 credential | The app's S3 key is the RustFS root credential. Per-application credentials are not yet introduced. |
| `force_ssl` off | HTTP behind the VPN is by design. Enable `FORCE_SSL` at build time if the app is ever exposed publicly. |
| Fingerprint coverage of legacy postings | Exact-file protection covers historical entries only after `bin/backfill_document_fingerprints` reports complete coverage. Missing objects and unresolved same-user collisions stay null and are not protected (see [operations.md](operations.md#document-fingerprint-backfill)). |
| Confirmed reuses are not DB-constrained | A confirmed file reuse is excluded from the unique index; the "no field match" condition is checked in the posting transaction, not by a constraint, so two simultaneous postings by the same user could both pass it. |
| Temporary test-only `hackney` override | Testcontainers 2.4.0 requires vulnerable Hackney 1.x. A test-only `~> 4.9` override keeps it on the patched line; the locked Tesla 1.21.2 supports Hackney 4.x. Hackney remains excluded from production, but its required IDNA 7.1 upgrade is shared with production's JSV and Swoosh dependencies, whose constraints allow it. Remove the override once a published Testcontainers release includes [upstream's Hackney 4 support](https://github.com/testcontainers/testcontainers-elixir/commit/f73bac030ffa40beb34793470d8d29d56ad4b03c), preserving a patched lockfile. Validate Docker compatibility with `RUN_INTEGRATION=true mix test test/zaimu_tomo/storage/rustfs_integration_test.exs` when updating this dependency. |
| Hackney 4 Unix-socket pooling | Hackney 4.8.5's default pool replaces the Unix-socket transport with TCP, producing `:nxdomain` for Testcontainers' Docker socket path. `config/test.exs` disables Hackney's default pool so Docker requests retain their Unix-socket transport. Remove this test-only workaround once a fixed Hackney release passes the RustFS integration tests with pooling enabled. |
| Resolved dependency advisories (2026-10-26) | ReqLLM 1.29.0 fixes WebSocket TLS verification (CVE-2026-107685); Plug.Crypto 2.2.1 fixes secret-bearing stack traces (CVE-2026-105963). Both advisories were published after the successful October 23 nightly audit. Bandit 1.14.0 and test-only Hackney 4.9.1 also resolve the advisories published later on October 26. Direct dependency requirements exclude the vulnerable lines; `mix.lock` pins the patched transitive Plug.Crypto release. Keep running `MIX_ENV=test mix hex.audit`: a green overall CI result does not guarantee a clean audit because the per-push security job is advisory. |
| Resolved TLS hostname advisory (2026-10-30) | `mix.lock` pins `ssl_verify_fun` 1.1.8 to fix [CVE-2026-117666](https://cna.erlef.org/cves/CVE-2026-117666.html), which let partial-label wildcards span DNS labels and wildcard DNS names match IP literals. It is a production dependency through OpenTelemetry Exporter → `tls_certificate_check`, and a test dependency through Hackney. Both parents' existing constraints accept the patch, so no override is needed. Their default SNI and OTP hostname checks mitigate this flaw on OTP 28; retain those checks rather than relying solely on the library callback. |
| Resolved HTML attribute and JSON Schema advisories (2026-11-03) | Phoenix.HTML 4.4.0 fixes attribute injection through unvalidated attribute names ([CVE-2026-117645](https://cna.erlef.org/cves/CVE-2026-117645.html)); the direct `~> 4.4` requirement excludes vulnerable releases. `mix.lock` pins JSV 0.26.2 to fix regex-budget exhaustion being treated as a non-match, bypassing JSON Schema validation ([CVE-2026-117680](https://cna.erlef.org/cves/CVE-2026-117680.html)). ReqLLM's existing JSV constraint accepts the patch, so no override or new direct dependency is needed. |

---

## 12. Glossary

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Extraction / extracted content | One processing attempt's result for a document (success or failed). |

URLs redirect there. Entries approved before booking was merged into posting are
still `uncategorized` and get a booking form on the same page.

### 6.2 Failure, retry and recovery

- **Transient error** (timeouts, 408, 429, 5xx, transport errors) on a non-final attempt: the job returns `{:error, summary}` and **persists nothing**. Oban backs off and retries.
- **Permanent error**, or a transient error on the final attempt (5): the job appends one `failed` `extracted_content` row and a `failed` review decision, broadcasts `user:<id>:document_processing:failed`, and completes.
- **Concurrency safety:** every terminal write locks the document row and checks that the latest extraction is still the one expected when the job was enqueued. Otherwise it cancels with `:already_processed`.
- **Crash or deploy mid-run:** `Oban.Lifeline` moves `executing` jobs back after 30 minutes.
- **User retry:** `DocumentProcessing.retry_document/2` re-enqueues documents in the `:failed` or `:stuck` state. The new run supersedes the old row, which stays as history. A successful enqueue broadcasts `user:<id>:document_processing:retried` so open views refresh.
- **UI state:** the documents Index and the processing hero derive each row's state from `DocumentProcessing.processing_states/1` (live job + latest extraction, two batched queries), the same semantics as `processing_state/1` on Show. A failed row with a live re-run shows "Processing" and keeps the failure note.
- **Operator recovery:** `bin/recover_stuck_documents` (see [operations.md](operations.md#stuck-documents)).

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> processing: upload (job enqueued)
    processing --> extracted: success row
    processing --> failed: permanent / final attempt
    processing --> stuck: job lost
    failed --> processing: retry
    stuck --> processing: retry or recover
    extracted --> pending_review
    pending_review --> approved
    pending_review --> amended
    pending_review --> rejected
    approved --> journal_entry
    amended --> journal_entry
    journal_entry --> posted: category + need/want
```

          scope = user_scope_fixture(user)
          a = pending_file_invoice(scope, user, digest, %{@rent | issuer: "Reader A"})
          b = pending_file_invoice(scope, user, digest, %{@rent | issuer: "Reader B"})
          parent = self()

          tasks =
            for pending <- [a, b] do
              Task.async(fn ->
                Sandbox.unboxed_run(Repo, fn ->
                  send(parent, {:ready, self()})

                  receive do
                    :go -> Review.approve_invoice(pending.extracted_content_id, user.id)
                  end
                end)
              end)
            end

          for _ <- tasks, do: assert_receive({:ready, _pid}, 5_000)

          results = Task.await_many(tasks, 10_000)

          assert Enum.count(results, &match?({:ok, _}, &1)) == 1
          assert Enum.count(results, &(&1 == {:error, :duplicate_invoice})) == 1

defmodule ZaimuTomo.Review.ReviewDecision do
  use Ecto.Schema
  import Ecto.Changeset

  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounts.User
  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent
  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedData

  schema "review_decisions" do
    embeds_one :original_data, ExtractedData
    embeds_one :decision_data, ExtractedData
    field :decision_type, :string
    field :rejection_reason, :string
    field :review_completed_at, :utc_datetime
    field :review_notes, :string
    field :review_status, :string

    belongs_to :extracted_content, ExtractedContent
    belongs_to :user, User
    has_one :journal_entry, ZaimuTomo.Accounting.JournalEntry

    timestamps(type: :utc_datetime)
  end

  @type t :: %__MODULE__{}

  def effective_data(%__MODULE__{} = decision) do
    decision.decision_data || decision.original_data || %ExtractedData{}
  end

  def changeset_for_create(attrs) do
    %__MODULE__{}
    |> cast(attrs, [
      :extracted_content_id,
      :user_id,
      :review_status,
      :decision_type,
      :rejection_reason,
      :review_notes,
      :review_completed_at
    ])
    |> cast_embed(:original_data, with: &ExtractedData.embedded_changeset/2)
    |> cast_embed(:decision_data, with: &ExtractedData.embedded_changeset/2)
    |> validate_required([:extracted_content_id, :user_id, :review_status, :decision_type])
    |> validate_inclusion(:review_status, ["pending", "approved", "rejected", "amended", "failed"])
    |> validate_rejection_reason()
    |> foreign_key_constraint(:extracted_content_id)
    |> foreign_key_constraint(:user_id)
  end

  def changeset_for_update(%__MODULE__{} = review_decision, attrs) do
    review_decision
    |> cast(attrs, [
      :review_status,
      :rejection_reason,
      :review_notes,
      :decision_type,
      :review_completed_at
    ])
    |> cast_embed(:decision_data, with: &ExtractedData.embedded_changeset/2)
    |> validate_inclusion(:review_status, ["pending", "approved", "rejected", "amended", "failed"])
    |> validate_rejection_reason()
  end

  defp validate_rejection_reason(changeset) do
    if get_field(changeset, :review_status) == "rejected" do
      changeset
      |> validate_required(:rejection_reason)
      |> validate_length(:rejection_reason, max: 1000)
    else
      changeset
    end
  end
end

defmodule ZaimuTomo.Accounting.JournalEntry do
  use Ecto.Schema
  import Ecto.Changeset

  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.TaxDeductionClaim
  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounts.User
  alias ZaimuTomo.Currency
  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Fingerprint
  alias ZaimuTomo.Review.ReviewDecision

  @need_or_want_values ["need", "want"]
  @duplicate_invoice_index "journal_entries_user_issuer_number_unique_index"
  @duplicate_source_file_index "journal_entries_user_source_document_sha256_unique_index"

  @typedoc "Journal entry schema struct"
  @type t :: %__MODULE__{
          __meta__: Ecto.Schema.Metadata.t(),
          id: integer() | nil,
          amount_cents: integer() | nil,
          currency: String.t() | nil,
          date: Date.t() | nil,
          description: String.t() | nil,
          issuer: String.t() | nil,
          invoice_number: String.t() | nil,
          category: String.t() | nil,
          need_or_want: String.t() | nil,
          status: String.t() | nil,
          notes: String.t() | nil,
          source_document_sha256: String.t() | nil,
          source_file_reuse_confirmed: boolean(),
          review_decision_id: integer() | nil,
          user_id: integer() | nil,
          review_decision: Ecto.Schema.belongs_to(struct()),
          user: Ecto.Schema.belongs_to(struct()),
          tax_deduction_claim: Ecto.Schema.has_one(TaxDeductionClaim.t()),
          inserted_at: DateTime.t() | nil,
          updated_at: DateTime.t() | nil
        }

  schema "journal_entries" do
    field :amount_cents, :integer
    field :currency, :string
    field :date, :date
    field :description, :string
    field :issuer, :string
    field :invoice_number, :string
    field :category, :string
    field :need_or_want, :string
    field :status, :string
    field :notes, :string
    # Posting-time snapshot of the source document's fingerprint. Only the
    # one-off backfill may set it on an existing row (see the backfill module).
    field :source_document_sha256, :string, redact: true
    field :source_file_reuse_confirmed, :boolean, default: false

    belongs_to :review_decision, ReviewDecision
    belongs_to :user, User
    has_one :tax_deduction_claim, TaxDeductionClaim

    timestamps(type: :utc_datetime)
  end

  @spec changeset_for_create(map()) :: Ecto.Changeset.t(t())
  def changeset_for_create(attrs) do
    %__MODULE__{}
    |> cast(attrs, [
      :review_decision_id,
      :user_id,
      :amount_cents,
      :currency,
      :date,
      :description,
      :issuer,
      :invoice_number,
      :status,
      :source_document_sha256,
      :source_file_reuse_confirmed
    ])
    |> Currency.normalize_and_validate(:currency)
    |> validate_required([:review_decision_id, :user_id, :amount_cents, :currency, :date])
    |> validate_inclusion(:status, ["uncategorized", "posted"])
    |> foreign_key_constraint(:review_decision_id)
    |> foreign_key_constraint(:user_id)
    |> unique_constraint(:review_decision_id)
    |> fingerprint_constraints()
    |> unique_constraint(:invoice_number,
      name: @duplicate_invoice_index,
      message: "has already been recorded for this issuer"
    )
  end

  @doc """
  Changeset for the historical fingerprint backfill: the only permitted update
  of `source_document_sha256` (and, for a human-resolved collision,
  `source_file_reuse_confirmed`) on an existing entry.
  """
  @spec changeset_for_fingerprint_backfill(t(), map()) :: Ecto.Changeset.t(t())
  def changeset_for_fingerprint_backfill(%__MODULE__{} = entry, attrs) do
    entry
    |> cast(attrs, [:source_document_sha256, :source_file_reuse_confirmed])
    |> validate_required([:source_document_sha256])
    |> fingerprint_constraints()
  end

  defp fingerprint_constraints(changeset) do
    changeset
    |> validate_format(:source_document_sha256, Fingerprint.format())
    |> unique_constraint(:source_document_sha256,
      name: @duplicate_source_file_index,
      message: "the same file has already been recorded"
    )
  end

  @doc "Name of the unique (user, issuer, invoice number) index."
  @spec duplicate_invoice_index() :: String.t()
  def duplicate_invoice_index, do: @duplicate_invoice_index

  @doc "Name of the unique (user, source file digest) index over unconfirmed postings."
  @spec duplicate_source_file_index() :: String.t()
  def duplicate_source_file_index, do: @duplicate_source_file_index

  @spec changeset_for_categorize(t(), map()) :: Ecto.Changeset.t(t())
  def changeset_for_categorize(%__MODULE__{} = entry, attrs) do
    entry
    |> cast(attrs, [:category, :need_or_want, :notes, :status])
    |> validate_required([:category, :need_or_want])
    |> validate_inclusion(:need_or_want, @need_or_want_values)
    |> validate_inclusion(:status, ["uncategorized", "posted"])
    |> check_constraint(:need_or_want, name: :journal_entries_need_or_want_check)
  end

  @spec need_or_want_values() :: [String.t()]
  def need_or_want_values, do: @need_or_want_values
end

defmodule ZaimuTomo.Repo.Migrations.SetBaseCurrencyDefault do
  use Ecto.Migration

  def change do
    # Rows created before the column default existed hold NULL; stamp them
    # with the base-currency default so the column can become NOT NULL.
    # New registrations pick up the same default from the column.
    execute("UPDATE users SET base_currency = 'CHF' WHERE base_currency IS NULL", "")

    alter table(:users) do
      modify :base_currency, :string, null: false, default: "CHF"
    end
  end
end

283	## 8. Crosscutting concepts
284	
285	### Data model
286	
287	```mermaid
288	erDiagram
289	    users ||--o{ documents : owns
290	    users ||--o{ financial_accounts : owns
291	    documents ||--o{ extracted_content : "processing attempts (append-only)"
292	    extracted_content ||--|| review_decisions : "one decision"
293	    review_decisions ||--o{ event_logs : "audit trail"
294	    review_decisions ||--o| journal_entries : "approved/amended"
295	    journal_entries ||--o| tax_deduction_claims : ""
296	    financial_accounts ||--o{ balance_snapshots : ""
297	```
298	
299	- `documents` stores `filename` (original name), `object_key` (`documents/<uuid>.<ext>`), and `content_sha256` (SHA-256 of the exact uploaded bytes, lowercase hex; null for legacy rows until the backfill reads them). The bytes live only in object storage. Replacing the object replaces the digest.
300	- `extracted_content` holds `extracted_data` (an embedded schema), `raw_llm_response`, an `analysis` map (verification and TypeSafe shadow results), `status` (`success` or `failed`), `error_details`, and the Langfuse `trace_id`.
301	- Money is stored in integer cents with an ISO currency code. Each user has a `base_currency` (default CHF), which is snapshotted into each OCR job as the currency hint.
302	- `oban_jobs` lives in the same database. Finished jobs are pruned after 7 days.
303	- Deleting a document that has a posted journal entry is blocked by a foreign key.
304	- A partial unique index on `journal_entries (user_id, lower(btrim(issuer)), lower(btrim(invoice_number)))` blocks posting the same numbered invoice twice per user. An unnumbered invoice matching an existing entry's exact `(issuer, date, amount, currency)` tuple is a soft match that requires explicit reviewer confirmation to post. See `Accounting.duplicate_candidates/2`.
305	- `journal_entries.source_document_sha256` is an immutable posting-time copy of the source document's `content_sha256`; `source_file_reuse_confirmed` (default false) marks a posting the reviewer explicitly confirmed as a reuse of the same file. The partial unique index `journal_entries (user_id, source_document_sha256) WHERE source_document_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND NOT source_file_reuse_confirmed` allows one unconfirmed posting per file per user. `Accounting.duplicate_check/3` ranks matches as same file > invoice number > same details; a file match is confirmable only when no field rule also matches (the tuple is compared against the file-matched entries even for numbered invoices). Confirmations are logged as `source_file_reuse_confirmed` events with the matched entry IDs. Fingerprints are user-scoped, redacted from inspect output, and never rendered or sent to an AI provider. Only `FingerprintBackfill` may set them on existing entries; there is no immutability trigger on `journal_entries` yet, and any future one must run after the backfill or allow it.
306	
307	### Multi-tenancy and authorization
308	
309	Every context function takes `%Accounts.Scope{}` first and filters by
310	`scope.user.id`. Routes requiring login live in `live_session :require_authenticated_user`.
311	Unscoped functions exist only for maintenance tasks (storage verification,
312	stuck recovery, fingerprint backfill) and say so in their docs.
313	
314	### Background jobs (Oban)
315	
316	| Queue | Worker | Concurrency (env) | Attempts | Notes |
317	|---|---|---|---|---|
318	| `documents` | `DocumentProcessing.OCRJob` | `OBAN_DOCUMENTS_CONCURRENCY` (2) | 5 | Unique per document while live. 10-minute timeout. |
319	| `typesafe` | `TypeSafeVerification.Worker` | `TYPESAFE_MAX_CONCURRENCY` (2) | 3 | Fail-open shadow run. |
320	
321	Plugins: `Oban.Pruner` (7 days) and `Oban.Lifeline` (30 minutes, which must exceed
322	the OCR timeout). Rules: job args are self-contained commands resolved at
323	enqueue time, and they never carry document text or provider payloads.
324	
325	### AI pipeline configuration
326	
327	OCR always uses Mistral. The extractor and verifier each take an explicit
328	`backend` (`nousresearch | mistral | flm | ollama`) and `model`. There is no
329	fallback. Prompts (`extract-invoice`, `verify-extraction`) come from Langfuse
330	(label `production`) when Langfuse is enabled, and from built-in local templates
331	otherwise. See [local-ai.md](local-ai.md) and [configuration.md](configuration.md).
332	
333	### Observability
334	
335	- **Tracing:** OpenTelemetry spans per document (`process-invoice` → extraction, verification, TypeSafe shadow), exported to Langfuse when it is enabled. The trace ID is stored on the extraction, so user 👍/👎 feedback becomes a Langfuse score.
336	- **Logs:** tagged prefixes (`[OCR]`, `[TypeSafe]`). Failures are logged as bounded summaries, never as OCR text or provider bodies. The default formatter includes the request ID and TypeSafe status, model, error class, and sanitized stacktrace metadata; development keeps its message-only format.
337	- **Health:** `GET /health` and `/up` (no session or auth), used by kamal-proxy and the Docker `HEALTHCHECK`.
338	- **LiveDashboard:** dev only (`/dev/dashboard`).
339	
340	### Security and privacy
341	
342	- VPN-only exposure, private bucket, and app-mediated preview and download (`DocumentController`, inline only for PDFs and images).
343	- Secrets come from environment variables at runtime (`config/runtime.exs`), supplied by Kamal from `.kamal/secrets`, which is not committed.
344	- Financial text is kept out of `oban_jobs`, logs, and error summaries.
345	
346	### Real-time UI
347	
348	PubSub topics: `user:<id>:documents`, `user:<id>:document_processing:success|failed|retried`,
349	`invoice_review:completed`, and `user:<id>:financial_accounts`. LiveViews
350	subscribe in `mount/3` when connected.
351	
352	Account settings renders inside the authenticated `zaimutomo` root layout.
353	Its `Layouts.app` call uses `shell: :product` to render content and LiveView
354	flash messages without duplicating the standalone authentication navigation.
355	Profile, email, and password remain independent forms; sensitive changes still
356	require a recent login. Settings styles are scoped to avoid altering other pages.
357	
358	### Testing
359	
360	ExUnit with the SQL sandbox. Storage uses the Memory adapter, HTTP uses
361	`Req.Test` stubs, and Oban runs in manual testing mode. Run `mix precommit`
362	before committing (compile with warnings as errors, unlock unused deps, format,
363	test), plus `mix credo --strict`, which is blocking in CI (§9 D15).
364	
365	---
366	
367	## 9. Architecture decisions
368	
369	Short decision records, newest last. Add one when a change alters structure,
370	infrastructure, or a cross-cutting rule. Older, longer feature-level reasoning
371	is in [`specs/`](../specs/README.md).
372	
373	| # | Date | Decision | Why / consequences |
374	|---|---|---|---|
375	| D1 | 2026-01 | Phoenix LiveView monolith with phx.gen.auth scopes | One deployable, server-rendered real-time UI. All data is scoped per user. |
376	| D2 | 2026-03 | Persist every extraction attempt as a row; one review decision per extraction | Keeps history, and humans approve before booking. See `specs/001`, `specs/002`. |
377	| D3 | 2026-05 | Journal entries only from approved or amended decisions | AI never writes to the books directly. |
378	| D4 | 2026-06 | Kamal 2 on a single VPS, app reachable only over WireGuard | Low cost, private by default. Postgres runs as a Kamal accessory. |

395	## 10. Quality requirements
396	
397	| Scenario | Expected behaviour |
398	|---|---|
399	| The app is redeployed while a document is being processed | Lifeline rescues the job and the document is processed exactly once (no duplicate terminal rows). |
400	| The LLM provider returns 429 or 5xx | Retried with backoff up to 5 attempts, then one visible failure the user can retry. |
401	| TypeSafe is down or slow | Extraction is unaffected. The shadow result records a failure. |
402	| A user opens another user's document ID | Not found (scoped query). |
403	| The VPS is lost | Restore from the off-host object export plus the Postgres dump, then `bin/verify_storage` reports zero missing objects. |
404	| Switching the LLM model | Env change and redeploy only. |
405	| The same file is uploaded and approved twice concurrently | At most one journal entry commits (unique index); the other review rolls back and stays pending. |

410	
411	| Item | Notes |
412	|---|---|
413	| Legacy upload volume | `zaimu_tomo_uploads` is still mounted (`config/deploy.yml`, `Dockerfile`) from the pre-S3 migration. Remove it after the restore check is recorded (see [operations.md](operations.md#legacy-upload-volume)). |
414	| Single host | App, DB, and object store share one VPS. Backups are the only DR mechanism. |
415	| No production mailer | `runtime.exs` configures no Swoosh adapter for prod, so email-based auth flows (confirmation, magic links) don't deliver in production. |
416	| Shared S3 credential | The app's S3 key is the RustFS root credential. Per-application credentials are not yet introduced. |
417	| `force_ssl` off | HTTP behind the VPN is by design. Enable `FORCE_SSL` at build time if the app is ever exposed publicly. |
418	| Fingerprint coverage of legacy postings | Exact-file protection covers historical entries only after `bin/backfill_document_fingerprints` reports complete coverage. Missing objects and unresolved same-user collisions stay null and are not protected (see [operations.md](operations.md#document-fingerprint-backfill)). |
419	| Confirmed reuses are not DB-constrained | A confirmed file reuse is excluded from the unique index; the "no field match" condition is checked in the posting transaction, not by a constraint, so two simultaneous postings by the same user could both pass it. |
420	| Temporary test-only `hackney` override | Testcontainers 2.4.0 requires vulnerable Hackney 1.x. A test-only `~> 4.9` override keeps it on the patched line; the locked Tesla 1.21.2 supports Hackney 4.x. Hackney remains excluded from production, but its required IDNA 7.1 upgrade is shared with production's JSV and Swoosh dependencies, whose constraints allow it. Remove the override once a published Testcontainers release includes [upstream's Hackney 4 support](https://github.com/testcontainers/testcontainers-elixir/commit/f73bac030ffa40beb34793470d8d29d56ad4b03c), preserving a patched lockfile. Validate Docker compatibility with `RUN_INTEGRATION=true mix test test/zaimu_tomo/storage/rustfs_integration_test.exs` when updating this dependency. |
421	| Hackney 4 Unix-socket pooling | Hackney 4.8.5's default pool replaces the Unix-socket transport with TCP, producing `:nxdomain` for Testcontainers' Docker socket path. `config/test.exs` disables Hackney's default pool so Docker requests retain their Unix-socket transport. Remove this test-only workaround once a fixed Hackney release passes the RustFS integration tests with pooling enabled. |

208	### 6.2 Failure, retry and recovery
209	
210	- **Transient error** (timeouts, 408, 429, 5xx, transport errors) on a non-final attempt: the job returns `{:error, summary}` and **persists nothing**. Oban backs off and retries.
211	- **Permanent error**, or a transient error on the final attempt (5): the job appends one `failed` `extracted_content` row and a `failed` review decision, broadcasts `user:<id>:document_processing:failed`, and completes.
212	- **Concurrency safety:** every terminal write locks the document row and checks that the latest extraction is still the one expected when the job was enqueued. Otherwise it cancels with `:already_processed`.
213	- **Crash or deploy mid-run:** `Oban.Lifeline` moves `executing` jobs back after 30 minutes.
214	- **User retry:** `DocumentProcessing.retry_document/2` re-enqueues documents in the `:failed` or `:stuck` state. The new run supersedes the old row, which stays as history. A successful enqueue broadcasts `user:<id>:document_processing:retried` so open views refresh.
215	- **UI state:** the documents Index and the processing hero derive each row's state from `DocumentProcessing.processing_states/1` (live job + latest extraction, two batched queries), the same semantics as `processing_state/1` on Show. A failed row with a live re-run shows "Processing" and keeps the failure note.
216	- **Operator recovery:** `bin/recover_stuck_documents` (see [operations.md](operations.md#stuck-documents)).
217

219	stateDiagram-v2
220	    [*] --> processing: upload (job enqueued)
221	    processing --> extracted: success row
222	    processing --> failed: permanent / final attempt
223	    processing --> stuck: job lost
224	    failed --> processing: retry
225	    stuck --> processing: retry or recover
226	    extracted --> pending_review
227	    pending_review --> approved
228	    pending_review --> amended
229	    pending_review --> rejected
230	    approved --> journal_entry
231	    amended --> journal_entry
232	    journal_entry --> posted: category + need/want

defmodule ZaimuTomo.Accounting.TaxDeductionClaim do
  use Ecto.Schema
  import Ecto.Changeset

  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.JournalEntry
  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounts.User

  @statuses ["undecided", "candidate", "not_deductible", "claimed", "disallowed"]

  @typedoc "Tax deduction claim schema struct"
  @type t :: %__MODULE__{
          __meta__: Ecto.Schema.Metadata.t(),
          id: integer() | nil,
          tax_year: integer() | nil,
          status: String.t() | nil,
          category: String.t() | nil,
          deductible_amount_cents: integer() | nil,
          notes: String.t() | nil,
          journal_entry_id: integer() | nil,
          user_id: integer() | nil,
          journal_entry: Ecto.Schema.belongs_to(JournalEntry.t()),
          user: Ecto.Schema.belongs_to(struct()),
          inserted_at: DateTime.t() | nil,
          updated_at: DateTime.t() | nil
        }

  schema "tax_deduction_claims" do
    field :tax_year, :integer
    field :status, :string, default: "undecided"
    field :category, :string
    field :deductible_amount_cents, :integer
    field :notes, :string

    belongs_to :journal_entry, JournalEntry
    belongs_to :user, User

    timestamps(type: :utc_datetime)
  end

  @typep persisted_journal_entry :: %JournalEntry{
           id: integer(),
           amount_cents: integer(),
           date: Date.t(),
           user_id: integer()
         }

  @spec changeset_for_create(persisted_journal_entry(), map()) :: Ecto.Changeset.t(t())
  def changeset_for_create(%JournalEntry{} = entry, attrs) do
    %__MODULE__{
      journal_entry_id: entry.id,
      user_id: entry.user_id,
      tax_year: entry.date.year,
      deductible_amount_cents: entry.amount_cents
    }
    |> cast(attrs, [:status, :category, :deductible_amount_cents, :notes])
    |> validate_required([
      :journal_entry_id,
      :user_id,
      :tax_year,
      :status,
      :deductible_amount_cents
    ])
    |> validate_inclusion(:status, @statuses)
    |> foreign_key_constraint(:journal_entry_id)
    |> foreign_key_constraint(:user_id)
    |> unique_constraint(:journal_entry_id)
    |> check_constraint(:status, name: :tax_deduction_claims_status_check)
  end

  @spec changeset_for_update(t(), map()) :: Ecto.Changeset.t(t())
  def changeset_for_update(%__MODULE__{} = claim, attrs) do
    claim
    |> cast(attrs, [:status, :category, :deductible_amount_cents, :notes])
    |> validate_required([:status, :deductible_amount_cents])
    |> validate_inclusion(:status, @statuses)
    |> check_constraint(:status, name: :tax_deduction_claims_status_check)
  end

  @spec status_options() :: [{String.t(), String.t()}]
  def status_options do
    [
      {"Not yet decided", "undecided"},
      {"Potentially deductible", "candidate"},
      {"Not deductible", "not_deductible"}
    ]
  end

  @spec status_label(String.t() | nil) :: String.t()
  def status_label("undecided"), do: "Not yet decided"
  def status_label("candidate"), do: "Potentially deductible"
  def status_label("not_deductible"), do: "Not deductible"
  def status_label("claimed"), do: "Included in tax return"
  def status_label("disallowed"), do: "Not allowed"
  def status_label(_), do: "—"
end
